name: Armorer's Cookbook 7

You will see this item in a room guarded by two Lion Imps right behind the Basilisk statue

Beware as the area is constantly being pummeled by lightning and there are several Giant bats guarding the scarab as well.

Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me – the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.

The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason - all for the perfection of the Golden Order.

name: Miniature Ranni

how: Looted off the ground just behind where Hornsent is standing. You'll also acquire the May the Best Win gesture alongside this key item.

how: Key Crafting Item. Found on a body hanging by the edge of the top part of the inner ramparts. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern section of the inner courtyard and following the ramparts as it curves to the west.

how: Acquired as a drop upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign for the second time.

name: Ritual Pot
how: Special Tool Key Item. Found on a corpse in the northern section of the Laskyar Ruins , in front of a set of pillars.

how: Given by Melina at the Site of Grace once you defeat Morgott, The Omen King .

name: Royal House Scroll
how: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

name: Ruins Map
how: Given by Ymir when first interacted.

name: Ruins Map (2nd)
how: Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

name: Ruins Map (3rd)
how: Given by Ymir after completing her questline.

how: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the room with the Banished Knight.

name: Secret Rite Scroll
how: Located on a table inside the room down the stairs, after progressing outside from the fourth floor. It's near the edge of this area.

name: Seedbed Curse
how: Key Item. Found after you exit the room with East Capital Rampart grace, continue south past the Oracle Envoys and into the building. Inside, head down the stairs and face west to take the elevator. After the elevator continue west into the next building. Climb up the ladder to your right and go up the stairs. On the highest floor you will find the Seedbed Curse on a corpse sitting in a chair.

name: Seluvis's Introduction

name: Seluvis's Potion
how: Key Quest Item. Given by Seluvis after accepting his task.

name: Serpent's Amnion
how: Found on the altar after defeating the Godskin Noble Boss in Volcano Manor .

name: Sewer-Gaol Key
how: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

name: Sewing Needle
how: Key Quest Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat. Return it to Boc the Seamster in the Coastal Cave to further his storyline.

name: Spirit Calling Bell
how: Key Item. Given by Renna . Return to the church after getting your horse to find her sitting by the ruins.

name: Storehouse Cross Message
how: Climb the feet of the statue and move towards the head, jump to the next area. You will find the item on a table, next to a Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace

name: Storeroom Key
how: From the top of the waterfall, you will find a room with a ladder, enter the room and climb the ladder. At the top, you will find a corpse with the Storeroom Key.

name: Tailoring Tools
how: Key Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat.

name: Talisman Pouch
how: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader. Dropped by Margit, the Fell Omen upon defeat.

name: Two Fingers' Prayerbook
how: Located in the first floor of Fortified Manor.

name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
how: Key Quest Item. Required to progress Gowry 's questline. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
how: Key Item. Found by climbing up the ladder in the central-western section of the courtyard that leads up to the top of the inner walls. Follow the walls northwest to find a room with a chest surrounded by statues and guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight .

how: Key Item. Can be found at the graveyard in the Village of the Albinaurics , near the town well.

name: Larval Tear #6

name: Larval Tear #9
how: Key Item. Dropped by Mimic Tear when defeated.

name: Larval Tear #12
how: Key Item. Dropped by a Silver Tear disguised as a large inanimate ball in Night's Sacred Ground .

name: Larval Tear #13
how: Dropped by a Silver Tear disguised as a large inanimate ball on the bridge.

name: Larval Tear #14
how: Rolls down the stairs across the bridge and then toward players are they enter this location

name: Larval Tear #15
how: Larval tear can be found here

how: Can be found southeast of Scorched Ruins. This can only be found at night as it's surrounded by glowing gravestones.

name: Larval Tear #20

name: Larval Tear #21
how: Found between glowing gravestones. Only available at night.

name: Larval Tear #22
how: Larval Tear looted from a spot of glowing graves available at night only, just south from Abandoned Ailing Village.

name: Larval Tear #23
how: South of the Church of the Crusade . Found between the glowing gravestones. (Only at night)

name: Larval Tear #24
how: Rauh Base. Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

how: East of Messmer's Army Encampment. Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

name: Larval Tear #26
how: West of Rabbath's Rise . Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

name: Larval Tear #27
how: West of the Ravine North Site of Grace . Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

name: Map Deeproot Depths
how: Map for entire Deeproot Depths area. Can be found on a corpse in a gazebo amid the destroyed ruins

name: Map Gravesite Plain
how: To find this Map Fragment, travel directly northeast from when you first entered the Shadow Realm.

name: Map Lake of Rot
how: Found on a corpse by the water's edge at Lake Rot .

name: Map Leyndell, Royal Capital
how: Map Fragment. Reveals the Leyndell region. Found on a monolith near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.

name: Map Limgrave, East
how: At the foot of a pillar with ancient writings on it. Unlocks Eastern Limgrave on your map.

name: Map Limgrave, West
how: At the foot of a pillar. Unlocks Western Limgrave on your map

name: Map Liurnia, East
how: It's in the middle of the swampy lake, by a monument that has highlightened texts over it.

name: Map Liurnia, North
how: Can be found over a grave-like big stone, at Academy Gate Town,

name: Map Liurnia, West
how: Map Fragment. Reveals western Liurnia. Found on a monolith along the road by a junction.

how: The map for Mohgwyn Palace reveals this entire underground location and its sub-regions.

how: Found at the altar. You can arrive by walking on the chain from the enemy encampment.

name: Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West
how: As you leave the Grand Lift of Rold, take the path forward until you reach a stone monument on your right, interact with it to obtain the map Fragment.

name: Map Mt. Gelmir
how: Map of Mt. Gelmir region

name: Map Rauh Ruins
how: The Map: Rauh Ruins map fragment can be looted by the foot of a monolith. To reach this location, make your way into the Scadu Atlus region. Starting from the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace located in Scadu Atlus, head northeast towards the hidden cave and follow the tunnel leading to the Ancient Ruins Base. Next, follow the canyon along and you'll find it just outside of the Temple Town Ruins.

name: Map Scadu Altus
how: The Map Fragment for Scadu Altus can be looted next to a monolith. When you pass the Highroad Cross Site of Grace through Castle Ensis, simply follow the road northeast.

name: Map Siofra River
how: Found next to the staircase leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds .

name: Map Southern Shore
how: From the Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace, follow the path northwest and you'll find this map.

name: Map Weeping Peninsula
how: Map for all of Weeping Peninsula .

name: Memory Stone #2
how: Memory Slot Upgrade Item. Found in a chest at the top of Lenne's Rise . The entrance to the tower is sealed but you can use a Spiritspring in the back of the tower to land on a balcony and gain entry.

how: Memory Upgrade Material. Found in a chest on the top floor of the Converted Tower .

how: Rewarded as a drop upon defeating Red Wolf of Radagon .

how: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the top floor of Testu's Rise .

how: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found on the top floor of Seluvis's Rise .

how: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Maggie upon defeat.

how: Dropped by Putrescent Knight

how: Drops from Fire Giant upon defeat.

how: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress. To be given to Enia to draw out the power within.

how: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax

how: Dropped Starscourge Radahn

how: Dropped by Commander Gaius .

name: Revered Spirit Ash #1
how: Can be found on a body hanging on the chandelier next to the Site of Grace.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #2
how: When you reach the Library, jump on the bookshelves and make your way to the other side where you see a large enemy. Defeat it to acquire a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #3
how: On a small altar. North-east of the Gravesite plain site of grace. Past the white tree filled with hanging bodies.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #4
how: Found at an altar located to the east of the Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace. In the vicinity of the pond inhabited by small turtles.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #5
how: Can be found on an altar in the Ellac River Cave near the Site of Grace.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #6
how: 2 Revered Spirit Ash can be found on the alter in the middle of the room infested by Spider-Scorpions.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #7
how: Can be found on the altar in the Village of Flies. Accessible only from Reclusive River Downstream area

name: Revered Spirit Ash #8
how: Climb up after defeating the two Gravebirds and you will spot a Shadow Pothead enemy. Grants 735 Runes upon defeat. Drops x1 Revered Spirit Ash and x1 Golden Horn Tender.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #9
how: After crossing the bridge with the Horned Warrior, turn left to enter an open area with a tree in the center and numerous enemies in prayer. You'll find the Revered Spirit Ash on an altar across from the tree.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #10
how: After defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, head to the right side of the arena to find a lift. Take the lift up and proceed forward to open a large door. Once through, you will find the altar nearby that has a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #11
how: x1 Revered Spirit Ash can be looted on a broken Revered Statue at the Abandoned Ailing Village. The statue is guarded by Man-Fly enemies.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #12
how: Outside the First Rise Site of Grace, take the stairs up and cross the bridge to a large enemy. Defeat the enemy to acquire a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #13
how: In an indoor Altar like room with Man-Fly(s) praying to an idol sculpture. The x2 Revered Spirit Ash will be at the base of the statue.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #14
how: Found East from Moorth Ruins, on a statue by the cliff overlooking Bonny Village. Beware of a Deathblade nearby.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #15
how: In Bonny Village: Fall down from the broken bridge, and follow the path north, past the dog, you will find a statue containing the revered spirit ash at the end of the road.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #16
how: Can be found within a small room on an altar. Be wary of Gravebird enemies in the area.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #17
how: South of Temple Town Ruins, you will see the altar near the edge.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #18
how: Found on the statue in the middle. Beware of enemies in the area.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #19
how: Found on the altar by the stone wall southeast from Ruins of Unte

name: Revered Spirit Ash #20
how: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead found above the lift near the scorpions and poison flower in Ancient Ruins of Rauh, along with x1 Silver Horn Tender, x1 Dewgem, and x1 Rauh Burrow.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #21
how: Dropped by a Shadowpot Enemy in the ruins west of the Viaduct Minor Tower Site of Grace.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #22
how: Climb up the statue's feet and carefully drop down the beast statue below, where you'll find a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #23
how: From the Seventh Floor Site of Grace, head to the opposite side, and jump on the railings on the left side and you will find this item on the hanging statue.

name: Scadutree Fragment #3
how: After getting past the two Spiritsprings, take the path on your right, and be careful of falling boulders. You'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment on a dead body.

name: Scadutree Fragment #4
how: x1 Fragment dropped by the Undead Hippo found in this area of Charon's Hidden Grave.

name: Scadutree Fragment #5
how: Located in a cave guarded by a Demi-Human Chief. x1 Scadutree Fragment is looted from a dead body inside the cave.

how: 2 Scadutree Fragments can be found at the Church of Consolation's by the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #8
how: x2 Scadutree Fragment can be looted in front of the altar inside the Abandoned Church.

how: x1 Scadutree Fragment is dropped by a pot-bearing Shadow enemy that sparkles and runs away. Kill it quickly to get the drop.

how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace near NPCs Sir Ansbach and Moore.

name: Scadutree Fragment #16

how: Upon reaching a large room on the northwest side with the 2 large Spider Scorpions in it and the Bone Bow , jump over the rubble on the right side just before the doorway to this room. There's another doorway just behind the rubble, and following the path beyond will lead to a small room with the fragment, next to a Miquella's Cross

name: Scadutree Fragment #18
how: From the First Rise Site of Grace of Enir-Ilim, progress the area until you're about to reach the Spiral Rise Site of Grace. Near the checkpoint, you'll find a stairway that leads down to a room where you can loot the Inquisitor Ashes. Outside of this room, jump down onto a broken staircase that might look like a dead-end. Check the east side of this staircase to drop onto the narrow edge of the w

name: Scadutree Fragment #19
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment drops from one of the two Hippopotamus enemies in the area. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream, and then carefully drop down to the bottom level to reach it.

name: Scadutree Fragment #20
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment drops from one of the two Hippopotamus enemies in the area. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream, and then carefully drop down to the bottom level to reach it.

name: Scadutree Fragment #21
how: BEWARE of a Deathblade nearby. South of Moorth Ruins, you'll find a pot-bearing Shadow towards the giant fissure at the center of the location. Instead of dropping down, wrap around the south side of the fissure to find the enemy. Kill the pot-bearing Shadow enemy to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment.

name: Scadutree Fragment #22
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found beside Miquella's Cross of the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #23
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Spiral Rise Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #24
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #25
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Highroad Cross Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #26
how: Location: Outer Tower of Enir-Ilim. After picking up the previous Revered Spirit Ash, continue heading up the stairs and you'll find a room with an altar where x1 Scadutree Fragment can be picked up.

name: Scadutree Fragment #27
how: Northwest of the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace, there is a Messmer Soldiers encampment. x1 Scadutree Fragment can looted by the statue of Marika.

how: Temple Town Ruins . From the entrance through the gap in the wall, take the stairs on the right and climb up until you reach the cloth-like part of the structure at the top. Before heading down, check on the right side to see a small opening that will lead to the middle platform. Fall there and defeat the two enemies, In the middle of the bridge you will find a body that has x1 Scadutree Fragment.

name: Scadutree Fragment #29
how: Head north from Moorth Ruins to find an area with a pond and a cave entrance that leads to Rauh Ruins. Cross the pond, and just before the entrance to the cave, you'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment that can be looted by the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #30
how: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace, head towards the building and climb up the stairs. Beware of the enemies in this room. Reach the end to find x1 Scadutree Fragment in front of the large altar.

name: Scadutree Fragment #31
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment found in a coffin at the bottom of the waterfall. To reach this area, you must follow the cliffs along the top and then find a place to drop by a graveyard with gravebirds, then explore upriver.

name: Scadutree Fragment #33
how: x2 Scadutree Fragment can looted off the ground. The item is found inside the Church of the Crusade, just by the foot of the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #34
how: Defeat the Lesser Golden Hippopotamus to obtain the fragment. The enemy drops 11960 Runes and x1 Scadutree Fragment .

name: Scadutree Fragment #35
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #36
how: Obtain x2 Scadutree Fragment after defeating the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep .

name: Scadutree Fragment #37
how: Past the Spider-Scorpions after entering the tunnel, move forward, and turn right. Locate the Shadowpot Enemy and kill it to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment .

name: Scadutree Fragment #38
how: Located at the Church District of the Shadow Keep . x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted on the hand of the statue of Marika. Time your jump to grab it. NOTE: Drain the water so you can jump onto the statue's hand.

name: Scadutree Fragment #39
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace in the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep.

name: Scadutree Fragment #40
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted in front of a small statue of Marika, located in the Dark Chamber entrance of the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse.

name: Scadutree Fragment #41
how: From the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace, enter the room to your right to find x1 Scadutree Fragment that can be looted on the ground, by the foot of the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #42
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #43
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #44
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #45
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #46
how: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Shabriri Grape #1
how: Key Item. Found next to a ghostly NPC in the underground section of Godrick's throne room.

name: Shabriri Grape #2
how: Can be found in a hidden cellar. The path is blocked by debris and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy. Once downstairs, you can find it on your left.

name: Shabriri Grape #3
how: Key Item. Dropped by Edgar the Revenger upon defeat.

name: Albinauric Shield
how: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.

name: Ant's Skull Plate
how: Greatshield . Found in a chest in a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Banished Knight's Shield
how: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
how: A large shield kept inside a chest at a camp.

name: Beastman's Jar-Shield
how: Found in the room next to the site of the grace.

name: Black Leather Shield
how: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.

name: Black Steel Greatshield
how: This shield item drops as a reward upon defeating the boss Black Knight Garrew .

name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
how: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.

name: Blue-Gold Kite Shield
how: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.

name: Blue-White Wooden Shield
how: Shield in Academy Gate Town (near Raya Lucaria Academy Entrance). Can be found on the outskirts of the buildings, towards the west side.

name: Brass Shield
how: Found southeast of the map in Limgrave. Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Defeat it to obtain a Brass Shield.

name: Briar Greatshield
how: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

name: Buckler
how: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.

name: Candletree Wooden Shield
how: In the Sage's Cave , in a chest behind an illusory wall.

name: Carian Knight's Shield
how: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight .

name: Carian Thrusting Shield
how: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. Past the Storehouse site of grace, continue forward you will reach a room where you find a Fire Knight and a few other enemies. The item is right past the Fire Knight and can be found on a corpse under the table.

name: Coil Shield
how: Located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir. You will need to drop down a hole and then double back.

name: Crossed-Tree Towershield
how: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel

name: Crucible Hornshield
how: Shield. Dropped by the Lesser Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges of the Siofra Aqueduct .

name: Cuckoo Greatshield
how: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself

name: Distinguished Greatshield
how: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

name: Dragon Towershield
how: Greatshield. Found in a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza until you see the archway leading into the building. Follow the linear path from here to a lower balcony with a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the terrace and look

name: Dragonclaw Shield
how: Greatshield that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel guarding the path into the capital.

name: Dueling Shield
how: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the eastern side, climb the wooden platform, and fight the Vulgar Militiamen. Use the stone platforms to reach the other side, the item is against the wall.

name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
how: Drops from Mausoleum Knights wielding it in Liurnia of the Lakes (chance to drop, not guaranteed)

name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
how: Ledge of the pillar near Tombsward Site of Grace. Can be reached from the ledge near Minor Erdtree

name: Erdtree Greatshield
how: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo

name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
how: Subterranean shunning grounds. Past the Altar you Fight mini boss version of Mohg. After defeating him you can roll/attack the altar behind the chest and it will move down out of the way revealing a path. If you have not defeated Morgott, the Omen King a seal will be blocking further progress. Following this path will lead you to the hardest part which is jumping from coffin to coffin to make your

name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
how: You can loot the Flame Crest Wooden Shield from a naked commoner's corpse inside one of the cabins.

name: Gilded Greatshield
how: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

name: Gilded Iron Shield
how: Shield. Found on a corpse sitting on a grave in the graveyard.

name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
how: Greatshield. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

name: Golden Greatshield
how: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

name: Golden Lion Shield
how: Given by Redmane Freyja after you hand her over the Letter for Freyja.

name: Great Turtle Shell
how: Small Shield. Found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
how: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
how: Medium Shield. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

name: Heater Shield
how: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
how: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

name: Ice Crest Shield
how: Small Shield. Found on a corpse up on a ledge by a jagged stone pillar. This area is in the gardens, jumping up on the rocks from the Teardrop Scarab nearby.

name: Icon Shield
how: Found inside a crumbling building. Beware of the enemies inside.

name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
how: Southwest of Siofra River Bank site, up a hill and past 3 enemies on a body.

name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
how: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Iron Roundshield
how: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

name: Jellyfish Shield
how: On a dead body surrounded by four Jellyfish directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.

name: Kite Shield
how: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

name: Large Leather Shield
how: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.

name: Lordsworn's Shield
how: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Man-Serpent's Shield
how: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

name: Manor Towershield
how: Greatshield. From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a large

name: Marred Leather Shield
how: Shield. Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.

name: Marred Wooden Shield
how: Medium Shield. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks . Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.

name: One-Eyed Shield
how: Shield. Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardian's Garrison .

name: Perfumer's Shield
how: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

name: Pillory Shield
how: Small Shield. Found inside Gaol Cave .

name: Red Crest Heater Shield
how: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.

name: Red Thorn Roundshield
how: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.

name: Redmane Greatshield
how: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

name: Rickety Shield
how: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

name: Rift Shield
how: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

name: Riveted Wooden Shield
how: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

name: Round Shield
how: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.

name: Scorpion Kite Shield
how: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.

name: Scripture Wooden Shield
how: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

name: Serpent Crest Shield
how: Obtained by completing the "Incursion" Painting Puzzle.

name: Shield of Night
how: Shield of Night is a new small shield that can be found in Bonny Gaol . The top level of this gaol can be accessed after using the jar lift near the bridge twice. You need to jump off at the bridge level, activate the switch, and then ride the jar going up. You will find this on the ledge behind the corpse on top of a table.

name: Shield of the Guilty
how: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins , before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.

name: Silver Mirrorshield
how: Shield found in the Apostate Derelict church.

name: Smithscript Shield
how: Jump from the opening left to the Lever, and instead of heading forward turn left. There are two Smithing Golems there, one that uses fire. Once defeated, stick to the right and go up to the upper platform using the crumbled column. You will find the item at the end of the hallway. Beware of the fire blob that falls from the ceiling.

name: Smoldering Shield
how: Small Shield. Found on a corpse on the sitting by some tombstones on the same level as the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

name: Spiked Palisade Shield
how: On dead body under a Golem, west of Deep Siofra Well, Caelid

name: Spiralhorn Shield
how: Found a corpse near Mausoleum Compound. NW of Ruined Labyrinth Site of grace.

name: Sun Realm Shield
how: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

name: Twinbird Kite Shield
how: Medium Shield dropped by nighttime spawn Deathbird near Leyndell's Hermit Merchant's Shack.

name: Verdigris Greatshield
how: Can be looted from Moore's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .

name: Visage Shield
how: Greatshield. Found in a chest in a small room behind the Mad Pumpkin Head duo bosses. Accessible after defeating them.

name: Wolf Crest Shield
how: Located inside a storeroom you'll find a treasure chest that has the Wolf Crest Shield. The storeroom is found by following the staircase down instead of heading into the chapel to fight Moonrythil

name: Wooden Greatshield
how: Greatshield. Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.

name: Adula's Moonblade
how: Dropped by the Glintstone Dragon Adula in the Cathedral of Manus Celes .

name: Ambush Shard
how: Weeping Peninsula : Found on a corpse in the underground jail of the Witchbane Ruins .

name: Ancient Death Rancor
how: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Liurnia of the Lake , to the east of Raya Lucaria Academy at night, south of the Gate Town North site of grace.

name: Briars of Punishment
how: Sorcery. Found at the leftmost dead tree next to three Lesser Fire Monks just before the long stone bridge with the Golem Archer at the end in the Mountaintops of the Giants region

name: Briars of Sin
how: Liurnia of the Lakes : Dropped by a mob directly north-west from the Artists Shack. Jump across the rocks and they'll be by a group of fire slugs.

name: Cannon of Haima
how: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

name: Carian Greatsword
how: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.

name: Carian Phalanx
how: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Carian Piercer
how: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab behind the gardens near the east.

name: Carian Retaliation
how: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Carian Slicer
how: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Cherishing Fingers
how: It can be picked up in the graveyard to the west of the Chathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline in full.

name: Collapsing Stars
how: Gravity Sorcery . Looted from a chest inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with 4 staircases, drop into the lower level from the left side to find the chest amongst the ghostly knights fighting each other.

name: Comet
how: Found behind an Illusory Wall before the Debate Hall Site of Grace.

name: Comet Azur
how: Sorcery . Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Azur .

name: Crystal Barrage
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Crystal Burst
how: Drops from the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins

name: Crystal Release
how: Sorcery Spell . Dropped by the Crystalians duo bosses inside the Academy Crystal Cave upon their defeat.

name: Crystal Torrent
how: Dropped by Crystalians Trio boss in Sellia Hideaway

name: Eternal Darkness
how: Night Sorcery . Found in a jail cell inside the Swamp Lookout Tower .

name: Explosive Ghostflame
how: Drops from a Death Rite Bird southeast Apostate Derelict (late game area). It's a clearing in the frozen river, and you must go there at night.

name: Fia's Mist
how: Obtained by defeating Fia's Champions in Deeproot Depths . After unlocking the Across the Roots Grace, head north and defeat the boss.

name: Founding Rain of Stars
how: Glinstone Sorcery. Found inside a chest at the top of Heretical Rise . You must access the tower by crossing an invisible bridge from the other side of the ravine.

name: Freezing Mist
how: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

name: Frozen Armament
how: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in an area behind Caria Manor. This area is accessible after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

name: Gavel of Haima
how: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

name: Gelmir's Fury
how: Glintstone Sorcery . Given by Resucant Bernahl after completing three contracts for Tanith at Volcano Manor .

name: Glintblade Phalanx
how: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Glintblade Trio
how: The Glintblade Trio spell is found by looting it off a corpse. After passing through the iron gate just beyond the chapel in the midpoint of the castle, then dropping off the side of the bridge and climbing up the ladders to the rooftop of the chapel. You can then drop down on the north side of the roof to get to the corpse hanging over a ledge that has the spell.

name: Glintstone Arc
how: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.

name: Glintstone Cometshard
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.

name: Glintstone Icecrag
how: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

name: Glintstone Pebble
how: The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Glintstone Stars
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Gravitational Missile
how: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast .

name: Gravity Well
how: Dropped by the Monolith Guardian enemy that appears from a gravity portal. The section is near the graveyard and the large rotating lift of Raya Lucaria Academy .

name: Great Glintstone Shard
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

name: Great Oracular Bubble
how: Sorcery . Obtained by defeating the Teardrop Beetle found inside the large stone ruin at the highest level of the Siofra River .

name: Greatblade Phalanx
how: Sorcery . Dropped by Bols, Carian Knight inside the Cuckoo's Evergaol .

name: Impenetrable Thorns (spell)
how: In Shadow Keep from the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, cross the center of the storeroom after pulling the lever to rotate the center beams. Once outside, carefully walk off the ledge (you'll see a bat below). You'll find the spell on a corpse

name: Loretta's Greatbow
how: Sorcery . Dropped by Royal Knight Loretta upon defeat.

name: Loretta's Mastery
how: Sorcery. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

name: Lucidity
how: Dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .

name: Magic Downpour
how: Magic Downpour is a Sorcery dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the Carian Study Hall.

name: Magic Glintblade
how: An old sorcery of the Carian Royal Family.

name: Magma Shot
how: Sorcery . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the first letter quest.

name: Mantle of Thorns
how: This item drops from the Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that emerges beneath the ground, near the large tree.

name: Mass of Putrescence
how: From the Fissure Waypoint site of grace, head northeast. Just after hopping over the little gap, drop down on the left (north) side and make your way north where you'll find the spell on a corpse.

name: Meteorite
how: Sorcery . Dropped by the Alabaster Lord upon defeat.

name: Meteorite of Astel
how: Gravity Sorcery. Dropped by Astel, Stars of Darkness , the boss of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

name: Night Comet
how: Night Sorcery spell. Found in a chest in the central section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

name: Night Maiden's Mist
how: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

name: Night Shard
how: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

name: Oracle Bubbles
how: Can be found by killing one of the Teardrop Scarab on top of a broken statue in the first structure on the right from the Siofra River Deep Wells site of grace. You have to go through some ruins and jump on top of them and follow them over to another side where there is a Teardrop Scarab down below. Kill he Scarab to get this spell

name: Rancorcall
how: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab that can be found at the underground crypt of the castle

name: Ranni's Dark Moon
how: Sorcery Spell. Found in a chest at the top of Chelona's Rise after unlocking the tower's seal.

name: Rennala's Full Moon
how: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.

name: Rings of Spectral Light
how: Looted from the altar by the giant bird statue after defeating several birds

name: Rock Blaster
how: Glintstone Sorcery . Found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel , in a chest inside a shed at the top level of the main cavern.

name: Rock Sling
how: Gravity Sorcery . Found inside a chest in a cellar in the northern section of the Street of Sages Ruins .

name: Roiling Magma
how: Sorcery . Found on a corpse inside the Hermit's Shack .

name: Rykard's Rancor
how: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

name: Scholar's Armament
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Scholar's Shield
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Shard Spiral
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Shatter Earth
how: Sorcery. Found on a corpse in the second-to-last level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel . Inside an opening in the north.

name: Shattering Crystal
how: Looted off a corpse on the second floor, west side, of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops

name: Star Shower
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.

name: Starlight
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Stars of Ruin
how: Given by Master Lusat when interacted with inside the Sellia Hideaway behind an arcane ward in the second pit. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker to get through arcane ward (Acquired during Sorceress Sellen Questline).

name: Swift Glintstone Shard
how: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

name: Terra Magica
how: Sorcery . Found at the top of a tower in the middle of the Raya Lucaria Academy. This area is accessed by completing the Academy Crystal Cave dungeon and taking the lift behind the boss' door.

name: Thops's Barrier
how: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

name: Tibia's Summons
how: Drops from the Tibia Mariner at Wyndham Ruins .

name: Unseen Blade
how: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Form

name: Unseen Form
how: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Blade

name: Zamor Ice Storm
how: Snow Witch Sorcery . Found on a corpse in the southern section of the Zamor Ruins , by a stone archway.

name: Albinauric Ashes
how: Found on a corpse in the graveyard area east of Caria Manor . This area is accessible only after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

name: Ancestral Follower Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Obtained from defeating the Ancestor Spirit in Siofra River .

name: Ancient Dragon Florissax
how: WARNING: DOING THIS WILL LOCK YOU OUT OF THE PRIESTESS HEART (The one that buffs dragon cult incantations, You can get a different dragon transformations stone called ''Rock Heart'' from another place that buffs dragon communion spells instead.) Find Thiollier near Pillar Path Cross (after the bridge and on your way to dragon's pit, the leftmost/eastmost path leading to a small swamp on map). Exha

name: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff
how: Spirit Ash Summon. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor found in the Sainted Hero's Grave .

name: Archer Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse tucked behind a building in Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Located on a corpse after taking the rotating lift down in Raya Lucaria Academy.

name: Azula Beastman Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. The ashes can be found on the sarcophagus in the back.

name: Banished Knight Engvall
how: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the boss of Murkwater Catacombs: Grave Warden Duelist, after Patch 1.03.

name: Banished Knight Oleg
how: This Spirit is obtained after Defeating the Ulcerated Tree Sprit located within Fringefolk Hero's Grave .

name: Battlemage Hugues (Spirit Ash)
how: Boss of Sellia Evergaol , drops Battlemage Hugues Ashes

name: Bigmouth Imp Ashes
how: The Bigmouth Imp Ashes can be found inside a treasure chest at the Darklight Catacombs location.

name: Black Knife Tiche
how: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader upon defeat.

name: Black Knight Captain Huw
how: Scorpion River Catacombs . Past the first ceiling with the falling spikes, reach the Yellow Fulgurbloom and turn right, you will see x2 Messmer Soldiers and a Black Knight. Between both of you, there is another ceiling with spikes, be mindful when engaging in combat. Once those enemies are defeated, head to the coffin at the end to find the Spirit Ashes.

name: Black Knight Commander Andreas
how: It's located by following the Fog Rift Catacombs past a black knight guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers and then jumping on to the top of the spike trap the falls from the ceiling and then crossing it into a corridor. The Spirit Ashes is lying in a coffin.

name: Blackflame Monk Amon
how: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear boss found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree .

name: Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes
how: Dropped by the Chief Bloodfiend at Rivermouth Cave.

name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
how: Dropped by the Red Wolf of the Champion

name: Clayman Ashes
how: Located on a corpse in Ainsel River, Lake of Liurnia which is south from the Uhl Palace Ruins. Easiest way to reach these is ashes is while doing Ranni's questline (the portal you enter from Renna's Rise will take you near the ashes). After entering Ainsel River proceed south along the tunnel entering into the next main room with enemies, proceed southwest while hugging the edge until you can find

name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay
how: Located in a chest protected by a knight in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree . From the Prayer Room site of grace, head straight down a few sets of stairs until you reach a small landing where two crossbow guards are stationed above. Jump over the railing on the landing onto the angled brace, then jump onto the platform with the gazebo. The ashes are in a chest in a room next to the gazebo.

name: Crystalian Ashes
how: Located in a chest protected by three masked magic users in a room that is located down a pathway up the purple crystals next to the Trio Putrid Crystallin's (bosses) boss door in�� Sellia Hideaway .

name: Curseblade Meera
how: This item is obtained as a reward for defeating Curseblade Smith found within Bonny Gaol .

name: Demi-Human Ashes
how: Found within Impaler's Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog

name: Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh
how: This spirit ash drops from the Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss located within the depths of the Belurat Gaol .

name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan
how: Spirit Ash. Found behind a hidden room in the secret passageway of Volcano Manor . After heading in the secret passage, before going downstairs, turn left and go through the hallway full of snails. At the dead end where you get the cookbook, smack the left wall to reveal the hidden room.

name: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
how: Spirit Ashes. Climb the crumbled structure of the building in Temple Town Ruins which can only be reachbed by jumping on the Spiritspring. Once on top, turn right and jump to the platform. Move forward inside the cave, turn left and enter the room with a chest containing this item.

name: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
how: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went thei

name: Dung Eater Puppet
how: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.

name: Fanged Imp Ashes
how: Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.

name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
how: Spirit Ashes . Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

name: Fingercreeper Ashes
how: Go east from Fingerstone hill Grace. You'll find a two fingers emote but continue onward until you find 2 leech-men as well as 2 hands buried in the ground. Soon after those hands there's an opening in the ground by the cliff guarded by many fingercreepers. Drop down and face against a GIANT hand, defeat it (fire works well) and grab the spirit ashes.

name: Fire Knight Hilde
how: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the gear in which you found Wrath from Afar, jump towards the next platform and head to the ladder on the left. Climb it up. Once at the top, take the wooden beam on your left and turn right towards the lift. Activate the lift but quickly return to the platform. Another lift will appear do the same, and jump on the first lift Roof. Stay th

name: Fire Knight Queelign
how: Use Iris of Grace on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive the Spirit Ash Fire Knight Queelign .

name: Fire Monk Ashes
how: Spirit Ash. Found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. Continue through this path past two frost breath traps. The spell is found in a chest behind the second trap.

name: Giant Rat Ashes
how: Can be found in a wooden shack located left of the windwill.

name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
how: Inside Road's End Catacombs. Defeat the Spirit-Caller Snail to obtain.

name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
how: Found at the Cemetery at the west of Stormhill that is filled with Spirit Jellyfish, next to a grave. Check both sides of each grave to find it.

name: Gravebird Ashes
how: Use the spiritspring to reach the area, you'll find this item surrounded by gravestones.

name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in a graveyard in Nokron, Eternal City guarded by a Fallen Hawk .

name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found under a large decorative chalice in the northern edge of the main city proper.

name: Horned Warrior Ashes
how: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the left side.

name: Inquisitor Ashes
how: They can be found on a corpse in Enir-Ilim, beneath the second to last enemy before reaching the Spiral Rise site of grace (coming from First Rise site of grace).

name: Jarwight Puppet
how: Spirit Ashes . Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

name: Jolán and Anna
how: Found at the very top of Rabbath's Rise, only accessible by carefully dropping down from the Hinterlands area above. You can only obtain this Ashes if you progressed Count Ymir's questline and finished Jolan's invasion, then gave her the IRIS OF GRACE to obtain her Spirit Ashes. Interact with the puppet in this room and you can merge Jolan and Anna to create this spirit ash. You can interact again

name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
how: Found within Cliffbottom Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

name: Kindred of Rot Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in the Caelid Catacombs .

name: Land Squirt Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found at a grave with several groups of land squirts nearby on the east shore of Liurnia Lake. To reach it, start at the Gate Town Bridge site of grace, go down to ground level, and simply travel north along the shore.

name: Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ash)
how: In order for Latenna to be friendly and become a spirit, one has to have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) , give to the player by Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics .

name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
how: Found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave . After a floor collapsed, make your way back up and retrieve from a corpse.

name: Lhutel the Headless
how: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade inside the Tombsward Catacombs

name: Lone Wolf Ashes
how: Given to players by Renna at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave. Return to the Church after getting the ability to summon your Spectral Steed from Melina . You will find Renna sitting by the ruins of the church.

name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
how: Spirit Summon Ash. Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo bosses within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs .

name: Man-Fly Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes looted from a grub corpse in Village of the Flies. Can only be accessed by going down the river from Shadow Keep and unlocking the Recluses River Downstream site of grace area. The Ashes are found on the top part of the village, guarded by two shadow casters and several man-fly enemies.

name: Man-Serpent Ashes
how: Spirit Ash. Found on an altar protected by some enemies in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
how: When you reach the graveyard section, as you cross the other side of the bridge, make a hard left and drop down to find a path that curves to where the Marionette Soldiers are, kill the two soldiers and then loot the corpse that is hanging by the ledge to find this item.

name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
how: Found at the far north cliff, by breaking a petrified tree.

name: Messmer Soldier Ashes
how: From the area where you fight the Omenkiller, cross the whole room to the other side, it will lead outside, You will find the spirit ashes near a grave.

name: Mimic Tear Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue door in Nokron, Eternal City .

name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found behind a hidden wall in Caelid Catacombs . You must attack a wall to the right of the staircase to reveal a path to the ashes.

name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
how: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux. Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.

name: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets
how: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue in Nokstella, Eternal City protected by two Swordstresses .

name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
how: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog inside the Stormfoot Catacombs .

name: Nomad Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the capital. This is in a large, multi-level section in the east.

name: Omenkiller Rollo
how: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Fell Twins bosses.

name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
how: Miquella's Haligtree near Haligtree Town site of grace

name: Page Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in an altar right before you pull the lever to open the Boss Door.

name: Perfumer Tricia
how: Optional Duo Boss Fight. Perfumer Tricia is found at the end of the Unsightly Catacombs and is accompanied by a Misbegotten Warrior.

name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
how: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the boss of Gaol Cave : Frenzied Duelist

name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes found within War-Dead Catacombs Go up the stairs to the back right of the first room and go left. Past the archer at the end of the hall turn right, turning right again at the end of that hall past the greatsword knight. Jump through the window to the right near the end of this hall. Go left up the stairs and the ashes will be in a room in front of you behind a knight.

name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
how: Found inside a chest at the end of the Road's End Catacombs . Hit the final wall to dispel the illusion, allowing you to move on. Beware of the many Imps in the final room.

name: Redmane Knight Ogha
how: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in the War-Dead Catacombs located in eastern Caelid. To find the entrance of the catacombs, travel to the site of grace that appears after defeating Starcourge Radahn and proceed to head north until you have reached the upper most corner of the area, you'll be able to see the small door along the cliffside.

name: Rotten Stray Ashes
how: Found on a body within a broken building, there is a Rotten Stray nearby.

name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
how: Spirit Ash that drops from the Tibia Mariner

name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village .

name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist boss at the end of the Auriza Side Tomb .

name: Spider Scorpion Ashes
how: In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this.

name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
how: Obtained from Roderika form Stormhill Shack while pursuing her questline.

name: Stormhawk Deenh
how: Spirit Ash. Found in a chest on the wooden walkway above the southern wing's main room. Accessible from where The Stormhawk King key item is found.

name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
how: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Eye of Occulation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes. Note: if you don't get these spirit ashes, you cannot get the "Jolan and Anna" spirit ashes either.

name: Taylew the Golem Smith
how: Return to the platform in the middle that you have moved with the lever, and head up. Jump to the left once you are near the top. Take the stairs up in the area, and interact with the furnace to receive the Spirit Ashes along with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
how: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade boss of the Black Knife Catacombs

name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
how: Spirit Ashes found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading north to find a hidden area on the right with a statue. Head into the

name: Wandering Noble Ashes
how: Located on a corpse that is resting against a stone coffin in the Stormfoot Catacombs in Limgrave. Proceed through the catacombs as normal until reaching a ladder that is going up, once you've reached the top continue forward past some Jade Goblins until reaching a dead end room that is being guarded by two Jade Goblins, the corpse resting against the stone coffin will hold the ashes

name: Warhawk Ashes
how: Rewarded upon finding the location Prophecy Painting depicts. The location is north of the Church of Pilgrimage .

name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
how: Spirit Ash. Found on a corpse in a pit inside the Unsightly Catacombs .

name: Stonesword Key #1
how: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse partially hanging from a wooden platform. The platform can be found by walking down west from the nearby Site of Grace and back onto a section of the castle. Look to the left edge.

name: Stonesword Key #2
how: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting in a chair at the northern edge of the plateau, overlooking the sea.

name: Stonesword Key #3
how: Stoneword Key Found on the ground by a wooden barricade at the southern end of the Bridge of Sacrifice .

name: Stonesword Key #4
how: Held by a corpse within Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Look for the body on a platform above the chariot.

name: Stonesword Key #5
how: Stoneword Key Found inside a small room, protected by a Rat.

name: Stonesword Key #6
how: Stoneword Key found at Stormhill Shack next to the Site of Grace.

name: Stonesword Key #7
how: Found within the Gaol Cave , near Wakizashi .

name: Stonesword Key #8
how: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse inside a building section with a broken roof. Accessed from the very top of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.

name: Stonesword Key #9
how: Held by a corpse above the Grafted Scion .

name: Stonesword Key #10
how: At Stormveil Castle's Underground Crypt.

name: Stonesword Key #11
how: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting high above on a ledge connecting two buildings. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

name: Stonesword Key #12
how: On top of a large rock with bodies and chairs on top.

name: Stonesword Key #13
how: Stonesword Key. Found on a body in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well , near the cliff.

name: Stonesword Key #14
how: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse on a ledge on the outside of the tower. Accessible via careful platforming.

name: Stonesword Key #15
how: Found within a chest, in one of the small islands next to the Raya Lucaria Academy .

name: Stonesword Key #16
how: Found in Raya Lucaria through an Illusory Wall just before the Site of Grace at Debate Parlor.

name: Stonesword Key #17
how: Looted on a fountain, center of the academy's courtyard.

name: Stonesword Key #18
how: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave . Head to the left to where the Sages are, and enter the next room. You will find it inside a cage.

name: Stonesword Key #19
how: Held by a sitting corpse outside the Academy , beneath the bridge.

name: Stonesword Key #20
how: Key Item. Found on a body sitting on a chair, in the open field, north from Ainsel River Well.

name: Stonesword Key #21
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse in a semi-open area in the back of the temple to the east. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the temple and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right when you can and then another left into a long hallway. The said area is to the left at the end of this hallway and the corpse can be found in the crumbled edge past the pillars.

name: Stonesword Key #22
how: Key Item. Found atop the Frenzied Flame Village outer walls.

name: Stonesword Key #23
how: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a corpse on the Western Walls of Caria Manor. It is guarded by a Giant Crab.This area can only be reached by dropping down from Three Sisters after defeating the main boss, and finding the path from the south-west of the chapel's rooftop.

name: Stonesword Key #24
how: Stonesword Key. One found in the Sealed Tunnel . At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south. In the next chamber, walk on the overgrown root and jump to the right onto the wooden platform below, right in front of a tunnel. Follow the tunnel to find the key on a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #25
how: Found on a corpse located on a camp northeast from the Grand Lift of Dectus.

name: Stonesword Key #26
how: Found on a corpse below West Capital Rampart Site of Grace . Drop down, jump on petrified dragon foot onto barn, then into 2nd story wooden building.

name: Stonesword Key #27
how: On top of a gazebo, held by a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #28
how: Found on a small shack past the Fortified Manor, west of the Lower Capital Chuch Site of Grace. You have to jump around in order to reach it. There is a Smithing Stone (6) on that same shack.

name: Stonesword Key #29
how: Found in front of a grave, there are three enemies in the vicinity

name: Stonesword Key #30
how: Found in the lower platform, open a door and find it inside the chest.

name: Stonesword Key #31
how: On the rooftop of one of the buildings, held by a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #32
how: Stonesword Key . One found in the Aqueducts section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds . From the Underground Roadside site of grace, head northeast and drop down into an opening in the ground to enter the aqueducts. From here, head northwest past the rats and look for a tunnel on the right. Follow this tunnel until you see slimes and drop into the hole in front of them. Follow the path all the

name: Stonesword Key #33
how: At Auriza Hero's Grave , one can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.

name: Stonesword Key #34
how: Stonesword Key. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps then turn right to reach a second Chariot hall where two chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find the key on a corpse betw

name: Stonesword Key #35
how: Held by a Noble's sitting corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #36
how: Can be found behind an illusory wall, in the same room where you fight an Axe Skeleton, within Sage's Cave

name: Stonesword Key #37
how: Found at the exit of Rya's room, reachable through the window.

name: Stonesword Key #38
how: Held by a corpse lying on the stairs within the Volcano Manor area.

name: Stonesword Key #39
how: Key Item. Found under a large burnt tree near the cliffs.

name: Stonesword Key #40
how: Found on a body on a stone ledge, reached by traversing the rocks leading from the eastern wall all the way to the ledge. A set of slugs can be found underneath looking at the body.

name: Stonesword Key #41
how: Stonesword Key found on a corpse on a broken bridge near Corpse-Stench Shack .

name: Stonesword Key #42
how: Stonesword Key. Held by a corpse in front of the fort's entrance.

name: Stonesword Key #43
how: Stonesword Key. Found inside a small open structure in the northern section of the ruins.

name: Stonesword Key #44
how: Held by a corpse sitting on a chair, near the edge of the cliff.

name: Stonesword Key #45
how: Stonesword Key held by a corpse located on the rooftop in the northern section.

name: Stonesword Key #46
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse lying at the tip of a branch in Miquella's Haligtree canopy right behind you when you enter the area.

name: Stonesword Key #47
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse lying at the tip of a branch in Miquella's Haligtree canopy.

name: Stonesword Key #48
how: Stonesword Key found on a corpse at the very end of a tall ruined wall in Siofra River . A gust of wind can be found at the edge of the cliff closest to the ruin, boosting you up to the top.

name: Stonesword Key #49
how: Stonesword Key. Found on a corpse by the cliffs east of the mausoleum, behind some praying corpses.

name: Stonesword Key #50
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying by a ledge overlooking the ruined temple in Nokron, Eternal City with the deer carcass. This ledge is a level lower than the cliff with the spirit jellyfish.

name: Stonesword Key #51
how: Stonesword Key found by climbing across the wall's support beams and pillars in Siofra River .

name: Stonesword Key #52
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .

name: Stonesword Key #53
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying on a ledge overlooking the waters of Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Stonesword Key #54
how: At the top of the high building, accessed by jumping on the Spiritspring behind.

name: Aged One's Exultation
how: Talisman dropped by the Winter Lantern enemy you kill nearest to the Abandoned Church. These enemies can only be killed by executing a parry and riposte just as they are about to catch you.

name: Ailment Talisman
how: The Ailment Talisman can be looted from a corpse. The body can be found lying at the edge of an unfinished wooden bridge of the Abandoned Ailing Village.

name: Ancestral Spirit's Horn
how: Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit.

name: Arrow's Reach Talisman
how: Found in a chest inside the Tower above Stormgate that can be accessed going all around it.

name: Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman
how: Found on top of a tower at Fog Rift Fort . From within the door of the tower where Black Knight Garrew was, go through a gap between the tower and the rock wall to the right of the door. Take the stairs going up around the cliff, then at the top take the ladder to the right going up the upper level of the tower. On reaching the top turn left to take another latter leading to the uppermost level of

name: Arrow's Sting Talisman
how: Found in the chest at the top of the tower next to the Impassable Greatbridge.

name: Arsenal Charm
how: An iron charm that resembles a mass of weaponry. Boosts maximum equipment load. This talisman was derived from an unusual greatsword, once wielded by a hero hungry for vengeance.

name: Arsenal Charm +1
how: Upgraded Talisman found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. Drop down on the left side to an overgrown root below. Follow the root going upwards to reach an upper balcony above where you can loot the talisman from a corpse.

name: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
how: Dropped by the Black Knife Assassin found inside Black Knife Catacombs.

name: Assassin's Crimson Dagger
how: Dropped by Black Knife Assassin , found inside Deathtouched Catacombs.

name: Axe Talisman
how: Talisman. Found in a cellar underneath the Mistwood Ruins .

name: Beloved Stardust
how: Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

name: Blade of Mercy
how: Once you head up on the left side of the building, cross to the other side using the cloth-like material as a bridge, and enter the door on the left. Open the chest inside to find the item.

name: Blessed Blue Dew Talisman
how: Talisman, at the altar of the Church of Benediction .

name: Blessed Dew Talisman

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Chest on the Divine Bridge behind the Golem; Royal Capital only.

how: Talisman. Found in a chest west of the Divine Bridge Site of Grace. Guarded by a Golem.

name: Blue Dancer Charm
how: Dropped by the Guardian Golem within Highroad Cave

name: Blue-Feathered Branchsword
how: Talisman. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Stormhill)

name: Boltdrake Talisman
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse sitting against a tall brazier.

name: Boltdrake Talisman +1
how: An upgraded version of the Boltdrake Talisman. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

name: Boltdrake Talisman +2
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging off an opening in a tall tower south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Reaching this area is a bit complex: You will first need to head southeast to the large plaza guarded by a stationary Farum Azula Dragon which is constantly raining red lightning all around the area. From here, drop down a series of cliffs to the east to reach the opening at the bot

name: Boltdrake Talisman +3
how: Shadow Keep . From the Storehouse Site of Grace, First Floor, take the small stairs up and turn right while on the wooden platform. You will be attacked by a Fire Knight at a Distance, jump at what appears to be a dining area with tables and chairs to find the item there.

name: Bull-Goat's Talisman
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse inside Dragonbarrow Cave .

name: Carian Filigreed Crest
how: A talisman adorned with the royal crest.

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
how: Talisman dropped by Bloodhound Knight , the miniboss of Lakeside Crystal Cave

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +1
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging by a wooden ledge above the southern walls of the castle. This area is accessed by climbing a ladder behind the church in the southeast and following the walls west. Beware the very powerful dual sword knight guarding the area. He can teleport behind you and perform very long combos.

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +2
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an underground room in the northwest section of the Lunar Estate Ruins . The entrance is sealed by both an Imp Statue that requires 1 Stonesword Key , as well as an illusory floor that can be dispelled with an attack.

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +3
how: A +3 variant of the Cerulean Amber Medallion can be obtained after defeating the Death Knight .

name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
how: Found at Carian Study Hall . look for it at the rafters, next to a body.

name: Cerulean Seed Talisman +1
how: Can be found at the center of the Finger Ruins of Dheo. You need to sound the hanging bell to acquire this talisman.

name: Clarifying Horn Charm
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse lying on the stairs leading to the lift going up to the Deep Siofra Well .

name: Clarifying Horn Charm +1
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse in the middle and at the lowest floor of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .

name: Clarifying Horn Charm +2
how: Lamenter's Gaol. After dropping down the small cave infested with rats, continue following the path and go straight. You'll find this talisman on a corpse on the right side once you enter the area.

name: Claw Talisman
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse atop a tower accessible by ladder. The tower has several none-hostile Eagles at the top.

name: Companion Jar
how: A talisman given by the jars to their friends. Raises potency of thrown jars.

name: Concealing Veil
how: Talisman dropped by the Black Knife Assassin boss within Sage's Cave

name: Crepus's Vial
how: Talisman . Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.

name: Crimson Amber Medallion
how: Crimson Amber Medallion +2 . Held by a corpse hanging over one of the wooden beams on your way down.

name: Crimson Amber Medallion +1
how: Talisman. Found at the top of a room locked behind an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

name: Crimson Amber Medallion +2
how: By falling down the sewers gate, on the beam below, just before fully entering the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

name: Crimson Amber Medallion +3
how: A +3 variant of the Crimson Amber Medallion drops as a reward upon defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .

name: Crimson Seed Talisman
how: Talisman. Found in a room inside the Sainted Hero's Grave , locked behind an Imp Statue seal. The room is right in front of the Site of Grace near the entrance and requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

name: Crimson Seed Talisman +1
how: In the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia. Go to the large ring of fingers (as shown by the Ruins Map given by Count Ymir), and then sound the hanging bell from one of the fingers that's pointing down. The Hole-Laden Necklace given by Ymir is required to sound it.

name: Crucible Feather Talisman
how: Talisman found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave . Reaching it is quite complex: From the first Chariot Hall, drop down through the opening on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps, then turn right into the next corridor that leads to a large hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down towa

name: Crucible Knot Talisman
how: Dropped by Omenkiller , located in the Village of the Albinaurics

name: Crucible Scale Talisman
how: Leyndell Catacombs , Altus Plateau . Found in the mini-dungeon directly behind the fire pillar trap is a room with an Omen enemy guarding the item on an altar.

name: Crusade Insignia
how: The Crusade Insignia Talisman is acquired upon defeating the Fire Knight Queelign NPC Invader.

name: Curved Sword Talisman
