how: Talisman. Found in Stormveil Castle, a chest inside a dark room in the Wine Cellar with the Banished Knight .

name: Daedicar's Woe
how: Disturbing likeness of a woman whose skin was flayed. She smiles with a serene tenderness.

name: Dagger Talisman
how: Talisman . Found in a room locked by an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon. The room is opposite the balcony where you find the Volcano Manor Waygate. Once inside, drop down two cages, then look for a red candle behind you that shows an obscure pathway to the talisman.

name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
how: Talisman. Found in a chest on an elevated platform inside the large building in the northeast, guarded by several Pests. This platform can be reached by heading through the eastern exit from the Drainage Channel site of grace and then navigating across the branches and concrete beams to reach the roof of the building. While there are many branches and beams to traverse, the path is fairly linear.

name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
how: Talisman found on one of the edges of Bestial Sanctum

name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1
how: Can be found in a locked imp's room in Sainted Hero's Grave .

name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris in the north of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Once you reach the lowest platforms, turn around and look for a sm

name: Dried Bouquet
how: Found in a small room hidden behind debris in the area you fight several Man-Fly enemies. From where you got the Bone Bow, as you exit the doorway, make a hard left and you'll see a pile of rubble that you can jump on and you'll see there's a secret room tucked behind it. Go inside a large storeroom where you can find the following items: x5 Thin Beast Bones, x1 Scadutree Fragment, and x1 Dried Bo

name: Erdtree's Favor
how: Head down until you see the path narrow on both sides and drop just at the edge where it begins to find a secret area. Defeat the imps and proceed past the fire trap to find the item resting at an altar. Two Grafted Scions wait hanging above, so be sure to avoid them when they land and grab it really quickly

name: Erdtree's Favor +1
how: Found inside a chest, in the room where you fight Mohg, The Omen

name: Erdtree's Favor +2
how: Upgraded Talisman . This Talisman may only be accessed near endgame/post-game. Found on top of a branch jutting out of the ground in a large courtyard, guarded by three Ulcerated Tree Spirits .

name: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
how: Located on a corpse guarded by two Prawn Miner inside Sellia Crystal Tunnel

name: Fine Crucible Feather Talisman
how: Climb up on the first tree branch and jump on the second one on the left to find the talisman.

name: Fire Scorpion Charm
how: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation. Found next to the talking spirit on the top of the walls.

name: Flamedrake Talisman
how: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula boss inside Groveside Cave .

name: Flamedrake Talisman +1
how: Found on the ground, against a column. The path is a blocked by a magic barrier if Morgott has not been defeated. You can still reach it by going slightly

name: Flamedrake Talisman +2
how: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula duo bosses in Dragonbarrow Cave .

name: Flamedrake Talisman +3
how: A +3 variation of the Flamedrake Talisman can be found inside a chest. You'll have to go over the cages and on the right side, you'll find the chest that contains the talisman.

name: Flock's Canvas Talisman

missable.lockedBy: Not completing Millicent's questline to either conclusion
missable.note: From Gowry's corpse after Millicent's questline concludes (either path).

how: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a mass of masked figures. Greatly raises potency of incantations.

name: Furled Finger's Trick-Mirror
how: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.

name: Godfrey Icon
how: Talisman . Dropped by Godefroy the Grafted when defeated.

name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
how: Talisman. Dropped by the Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble upon their defeat in the Spiritcaller's Cave .

name: Gold Scarab
how: A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

name: Golden Braid
how: The talisman can be looted from the ground, in front of a statue of Marika that is inside a tree trunk near the Shaman Village. The Shaman Village is located in Scaduview, which can be accessed by using the O Mother gesture in front of the statue of Marika located near the Back Gate Site of Grace of the Shadow Keep.

name: Graven-Mass Talisman
how: Talisman found in a chest atop the Albinauric Rise tower.

name: Graven-School Talisman
how: Talisman. Found beyond the illusory wall before the Red Wolf of Radagon boss fight. Go up the ladder close to the Debate Hall Site of Grace and then down the hole to another the room with potboys. This opens the door inaccessible as you entered this area.

name: Great-Jar's Arsenal
how: Reward for completing the 3 duelist NPC invasions in Dragonbarrow (Caelid North) for The Great-Jar. You will only be able to access this area by coming up from Siofra Deep River Well in the underground.

name: Greatshield Talisman
how: Found in a chest on a Wagon East of Grace "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" behind Ancient Dragon Lansseax.

name: Green Turtle Talisman
how: Talisman. Found in an underground area filled with Turtles . The entrance is found slightly south-east of Summonwater Village and requires 1 Stonesword Key to unlock.

name: Haligdrake Talisman
how: Talisman. Drop down from the cliff near the Seaside Ruins site of grace. Explore the lower area and between fallen columns, there is a small entrance. Enter and take the path until you fing a hanging body.There you will find the Haligdrake Talisman - this is the unreachable item seen in the Cave of Knowledge starting tutorial

name: Haligdrake Talisman +1
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse next to a Lesser Spirit-Caller Snail inside the Leyndell Catacombs . From the Lyndell Catacombs site of grace, head up the elevator in the southeast to find a room with 3 spirit crossbowmen. Look next to the stairs for an illusory wall. Hit it to dispel the illusion, and then hit the wall on the left to dispel another illusion. The corpse and snail are found in

name: Haligdrake Talisman +2
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse by a small cluster of graves southwest of the blood marsh.

name: Hammer Talisman
how: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.

name: Host's Trick-Mirror
how: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.

name: Immunizing Horn Charm
how: Talisman. Found on one of the corpses in this ant nest.

name: Immunizing Horn Charm +1
how: Found in the Lake of Rot by killing the Ancestral follower SE of the Lake of Rot Shore Grace

name: Immunizing Horn Charm +2
how: Talisman. +2 Version of the Immunizing Horn Charm is dropped by the Lesser Ulcerated Spirit that appears in the poison swamp area of Belurat Tower Settlement.

name: Kindred of Rot's Exultation
how: Talisman. Dropped by the Kindred of Rot .

name: Lance Talisman
how: Found at the north of Limgrave past the main road close to the edge.

name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
how: Found in Wyndham Catacombs in a room sealed by an Imp Statue, requires a Stonesword Key .

name: Longtail Cat Talisman
how: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the bottom section of the large rotating lift. Past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy, simply ride the lift down and defeat the single Pendulum Statue enemy.

name: Lord of Blood's Exultation
how: Drops from Esgar, Priest of Blood in Leyndell Catacombs .

name: Magic Scorpion Charm
how: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.

name: Marika's Scarseal
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse at the base of the waterfall found at the highest level of Siofra River . It is close to where the Dragonkin Soldier is fought.

name: Marika's Soreseal
how: Talisman . Found on an altar in a room requiring 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock. This room is in the southeast, on the lower levels.

name: Millicent's Prosthesis

missable.lockedBy: Assist path at Elphael (gold summon sign) or incomplete Millicent questline
missable.note: From Millicent's corpse on the betray path (red sign). Mutually exclusive with Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.

how: When you are given the choice between assisting Millicent and challenging her, choose to challenge her. When you kill her, you will automatically receive this talisman.

name: Moon of Nokstella
how: Talisman . Found in a chest underneath a massive throne in Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Mottled Necklace
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse at the edge of the ruined bridge. This area is accessed via Waygate from The Four Belfries .

name: Mottled Necklace +1
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on top of some ruined arches in Nokron, Eternal City .

name: Mottled Necklace +2
how: Talisman found in the upper area of Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the spiritspring in the area to reach the platform to the east and go up the stairs, at the end of the path you'll find a chest with this Talisman.

name: Old Lord's Talisman
how: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a rotunda on the east edge of the Dragon Temple Rooftop area. This area is accessed by heading north from the Great Bridge and entering the building there. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder nearby down to the walkway leading to the rotunda. Beware as the chest is surrounded by Beastmen and, if you've killed Rykard in the Volcano Manor , you wi

name: Outer God Heirloom
how: Found inside a chest, at the top of Prospect Town. Inside a small building.

name: Pearl Shield Talisman
how: Found inside a chest in a small camp of Messmer soldiers in the woods. Southwestern of Taylew's Ruined Forge Site of Grace.

name: Pearldrake Talisman
how: Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon. Boosts non-physical damage negation.

name: Pearldrake Talisman +1
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an cellar near the top of the Wyndham Ruins . The entrance requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

name: Pearldrake Talisman +2
how: Talisman . Down the steps and up the ladder from the Haligtree Town Site of Grace, there is a Rot Grease. The platform behind that has the Pearldrake Talisman.

name: Pearldrake Talisman +3
how: After using the lever to move the statues in Specimen Storeroom, head to the second floor where the Fire Knight is gazing at the center of the room in the wooden structure. Head to his right and reach the rail to find the statue's head with this item.

name: Perfumer's Talisman
how: In a chest underground below stairs in the room with the yellow Giant Poison Flower.

name: Primal Glintstone Blade
how: Talisman. Found in an underground area of the Stargazer's Ruins . The entrance is sealed by a barrier and there is a talking jellyfish atop the steps. Summon the Spirit Jellyfish next to her to unlock the seal.

name: Prince of Death's Cyst
how: Dropped by a Runebear, fiound in a cave behind a waterfall

name: Prince of Death's Pustule
how: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the pit of the castle's crypt after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit . The body can be found next to a giant face.

name: Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom
how: Finish the sidequest given by Gowry in Caelid, then return to Millicent to receive the talisman.

name: Radagon Icon
how: Found inside a treasure chest on the second floor of the Debate Hall Site of Grace. From the gate entrance leading to the courtyard, make a hard right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and head through the broken glass window. The treasure chest is on the east section.

name: Radagon's Scarseal
how: Dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor

name: Radagon's Soreseal
how: Talisman. Found on a corpse by dropping down the opening on the roof and looking around the wooden walkways.

name: Red-Feathered Branchsword
how: Dropped by the Deathbird at Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Rellana's Cameo
how: The talisman can be looted on top of an altar inside a chapel.

name: Ritual Shield Talisman
how: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, follow the marble stairway heading South-Southwest, past a Valiant Gargoyle near a Golden Seed and up the stair toward a giant Colloseum, the talisman is at the top of the hill, in front of the door of the Colloseum.

name: Ritual Sword Talisman
how: Located in Lux Ruins , in a chest after defeating Demi-Human Queen Gilika

name: Roar Medallion
how: Dropped by Stonedigger Troll . Located in Limgrave Tunnels.

name: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia

missable.lockedBy: Betray path at Elphael (red summon sign) or incomplete Millicent questline
missable.note: From Millicent's corpse on the assist path (gold sign vs her four sisters at Elphael). Mutually exclusive with Millicent's Prosthesis.

how: Earned after choosing to assist Millicent and successfully defeat her sisters.

name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
how: Talisman. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.

name: Sacrificial Twig
how: Special Consumable Talisman. Found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

name: Shabriri's Woe
how: Found on a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village

name: Shard of Alexander
how: Drops from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline.

name: Sharpshot Talisman
how: Found inside Albinauric's Shack

name: Shattered Stone Talisman
how: Moorth Ruins. Fall on the first rooftop visible from the gap on the ground, turn left, and walk on the ledge to find the Talisman.

name: Silver Scarab
how: Found in a chest in Hidden Path to the Haligtree . The chest is found past an illusory wall, behind a Grave Glovewort (9) inside the first alcove that you can access by jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase in the main hall.

name: Smithing Talisman
how: The talisman is looted from a corpse. The body is inside a room filled with Fire Blob enemies, on the upper-most level of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

name: Spear Talisman
how: Talisman found in a chest within Lakeside Crystal Cave

name: Spelldrake Talisman
how: Talisman. Acquired by defeating the Runebear boss inside Earthbore Cave .

name: Spelldrake Talisman +1
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found in a chest in a small room the northwest section of town. Right below where the Staff of Loss is obtained. This room is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

name: Spelldrake Talisman +2
how: Upgraded Talisman. Found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree by turning right just before the Stray Mimic Tear 's boss door, following the corridor and taking the lift up. The talisman is found on a corpse in an alcove at the top.

name: Spelldrake Talisman +3
how: A +3 variant of the Spelldrake Talisman can be looted off a corpse. The body is located inside a storeroom underneath the castle front bridge of Castle Ensis.

name: St. Trina's Smile
how: Obtained as a drop upon defeating Thiollier. Thiollier only becomes a hostile enemy if you pursue Thiollier and St. Trina's NPC quest. Please visit the Thiollier or St.Trina 's page for the NPC quest guide.

name: Stalwart Horn Charm
how: Can be found in Eastern Liurnia. Fast travel to Mausoleum Compound, head up the light incline to the left towards the cliff to the West. When you are at the cliff, look South for a hole in the wall. The talisman can be found on a corpse on a cliff through the hole.

name: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
how: Found to the east of Yelough Anix Tunnel

name: Stalwart Horn Charm +2
how: Bonny Gaol. After you jump down the hole, head east past the rats and climb up the ladder. Defeat the Inner Jar monster, you will find the talisman in the room.

name: Stargazer Heirloom
how: Talisman . Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .

name: Starscourge Heirloom
how: Looted from a chest in Fort Gael . It's outside the watchtower on the upper-section of the fort, under a canopy tent.

name: Taker's Cameo
how: Talisman . Awarded by Tanith after completing the third letter quest.

name: Talisman of All Crucibles
how: Start at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Starway Site of Grace, and head southwest to the elevator. At the bottom of the elevator looking south west, there are 2 paths of floating platforms, go to the left one, follow it around and it loops to the chest with this talisman.

name: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
how: Can be found beside the big golden tree.

name: Talisman of the Dread
how: Can be found on a corpse inside Elder's Hovel.

name: Twinblade Talisman
how: Talisman. Found in the tower section of the walls of Castle Morne. Climb up the ladder and go around the tower to find a chest containing the talisman.

name: Two Fingers Heirloom
how: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a hidden cellar in the Purified Ruins . The cellar entrance is concealed by wooden planks and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy.

name: Two-Handed Sword Talisman
how: Temple Town Ruins . After the fight with the Horned Warrior, just continue up to the next room to find a chest with this item inside.

name: Two-Headed Turtle Talisman
how: It's inside a cave beneath a waterfall guarded by enemies Just east of Rivermouth Cave

name: Verdigris Discus
how: Ancient Rauh Ruins: Can be found in front of a giant statue in a lower area only accessible by jumping down from the second Divine Beast Lion encounter, or by teleporting to this platform from the waygate in Scadu Altus

name: Viridian Amber Medallion
how: Viridian Amber Medallion Raises maximum stamina. It is dropped by Miranda the Blighted Bloom, found inside the Tombsward Cave.

name: Viridian Amber Medallion +1
how: can be found in Altus Plauteau, south of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace. You should hear Margit whisper, "I see you, Tarnished..." to you before appearing on the road. Defeat him again and it will drop.

name: Viridian Amber Medallion +2
how: The closest site of grace is the Haligtree Town Plaza. Run to the roof with the Summoning Snail, jump to the building on the right (it's lower), immediately turn around and jump inside the building. There will be a chest with the medallion and some mushroom people

name: Viridian Amber Medallion +3
how: Darklight Catacombs : In a chest found by dropping down a ledge in the main area, and going to the archway in the wall

name: Warrior Jar Shard
how: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.

name: Winged Sword Insignia
how: Talisman. Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight boss inside the Stillwater Cave .

name: Ancestral Infant's Head
how: Key Item. Found in a chest in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City . Guarded by an Ancestral Follower .

name: Ancient Dragon's Blessing
how: Given by Dragon Communion Priestess located near the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

name: Baldachin's Blessing
how: Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden

name: Blasphemous Claw
how: Reusable Tool. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

name: Blessing of Marika
how: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel .

name: Bloody Finger
how: Key Multiplayer Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item.

name: Blue Cipher Ring
how: Item for online play. Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. When summoned to rescue another player, your objective will be to defeat the invader.

name: Bondstone
how: Can be found behind an illusory wall inside a tunnel area guarded by scorpions

name: Duelist's Furled Finger
how: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

name: Finger Severer
how: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse by the wall just past the Site of Grace in the Stranded Graveyard. Found along with the Tarnished's Furled Finger .

name: Flask of Cerulean Tears
how: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

name: Flask of Crimson Tears
how: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

name: Flask of Wondrous Physick
how: Laying on the ground in front of the statue. Bestows various special effects.

name: Horned Bairn
how: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit found under the Ellac Greatbridge.

name: Iris of Grace
how: Directly below of the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks location. Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first floor site of grace. Take the first exit to the right and continue forward until the end of the hallway. Kill the enemy, and take the right path down. Kill the enemies and turn left all the way to find the item.

name: Iris of Occultation
how: This item drops from a second Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that can be found around this section of the sunken chapel.

name: Lamenter's Mask
how: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. Dropped by Lamenter at Lamenter's Gaol.

name: Lantern
how: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.

name: Margit's Shackle
how: A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time.

name: Memory of Grace
how: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.

name: Mimic's Veil
how: Reusable Key Item. Found in a chest inside the assembly room with the large war table. There is a Banished Knight in this room.

name: Mohg's Shackle
how: A fetish bathed in golden magic.

name: Omen Bairn
how: Doll of a curseborn bairn.

name: Prattling Pate "Apologies"
how: Reusable Item. Found on a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs , along the corridors in the room with the lever that opens the final door.

name: Prattling Pate "Hello"
how: Can be found in Stormfoot Catacombs on a corpse behind the first pillar that exudes fire.

name: Prattling Pate "Lamentation"
how: Lamenter's Gaol. Climb up the long ladder, cross the connecting stone bridge, and enter the room on the left, you'll find this key item on a corpse.

name: Prattling Pate "Let's get to it"
how: Found within Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau . Found by the entrance of the room with the shadow enemy that, when killed, opens the final door.

name: Prattling Pate "My beloved"
how: Pratting Pate " My beloved " can be found on Miquella's Haligtree , shortly after taking the way gate from Ordina, Liturgical Town. It is two branches down from where you are transported to.

name: Prattling Pate "Please help"
how: Found within Impaler's Catacombs , held by a corpse in the water underneath the spikes trap.

name: Prattling Pate "Thank you"
how: Reusable Item. Obtained inside the Tombsward Catacombs . Found on a corpse at the end of the main path, past the flamethrowing pillar.

name: Prattling Pate "Wonderful"
how: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs , in the very bottom level of the large multi-leveled hall. You can drop down to this level via the gap on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors here for several items, one of which is the Prattling Pate.

name: Prattling Pate "You're beautiful"
how: Tool Item. Found by a door just near the Hierodas Glintstone Crown in Hermit Village.

name: Priestess Heart
how: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.

name: Pureblood Knight's Medal
how: Key Tool Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item. Gives player early access to Mohgwyn Dynasty underground.

name: Radiant Baldachin's Blessing
how: Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity. Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor. It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.

name: Recusant Finger
how: Multiplayer Item. Found in a locked room with the Letter from Volcano Manor after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor .

name: Regal Omen Bairn
how: Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line.  Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.

name: Rock Heart
how: A special item obtained from completing the "Domain of Dragons" Painting puzzle. Allows players to transform into an Ancient Dragon

name: Small Golden Effigy
how: Multiplayer Item. Found on the Summoning Pool a few steps west of The First Step Site of Grace.

name: Small Red Effigy
how: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool.

name: Spectral Steed Whistle
how: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.

name: Tarnished's Furled Finger
how: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

name: Tarnished's Wizened Finger
how: Can be found at the beginning of the game, on a body against a wall on the right side of the tutorial area.

name: Taunter's Tongue
how: Item for online play. Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)

name: Telescope
how: Astrology tool used by members of the Carian royal family. Part of a larger instrument, removed and stolen away. Allows the viewer to better see faraway things. During the age of the Erdtree, Carian astrology withered on the vine. The fate once writ in the night skies had been fettered by the Golden Order.

name: White Cipher Ring
how: Item for online play. Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (You may be unable to summon rescuers under certain circumstances). A lost mystic code, enchanted to take the form of a ring. One of the fetishes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.

name: Wraith Calling Bell
how: Offensive Consumable Item. Found in a chest in a small room of an underground aea in the northwestern section of the Laskyar Ruins . Find a set of steps leading downwards to locate the area.

name: Academy Glintstone Staff
how: Staff. Can be found on Sorcerer Thops' body near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace after giving him the Academy Glintstone Key.

name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
how: Drops from an enemy in the Underground. You have to raise the platforms to get up to him by stepping on the buttons around the swamp. There are two buttons that are next to small columns or obelisks. Once you get raised on the platform, take on the long and narrow path, after a few meters you will be greeted by this enemy. kill him to obtain the Alabastrer Lord's Sword.

name: Albinauric Bow
how: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

name: Albinauric Staff
how: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Head left from the bonfire, then left again, taking the stairs to the next floor. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to be taken to a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and Albinauric Mask.

name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
how: The weapon is acquired after examining the altar of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The altar is found on the second level. To reach the altar, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.

name: Antspur Rapier
how: Thrusting Sword. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.

name: Anvil Hammer
how: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Use the column you have lowered with the lever as a bridge and climb it until the end. Beware of the fire blob, and then at the top, turn right and jump to reach the stairs. Climb them up and interact with a furnace to obtain this weapon and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

name: Arbalest
how: Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal: From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. Yo

name: Astrologer's Staff
how: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

name: Axe of Godfrey
how: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.

name: Axe of Godrick
how: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"

name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
how: Looted on the ground inside a room that is full of crystals. It's on the east side, the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo within Raya Lucaria Academy.

name: Backhand Blade
how: Besides a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies area.

name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
how: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Banished Knight's Halberd
how: An upgraded Banished Knight's Halberd dropped by Edgar the Revenger .

name: Barbed Staff-Spear
how: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor , and grants 260000 Runes upon defeat.

name: Bastard's Stars
how: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

name: Bastard Sword
how: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

name: Battle Axe
how: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

name: Battle Hammer
how: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs .

name: Beast Claw (weapon)
how: Drops from killing this hostile NPC in Gravesite plains in the forest, southeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

name: Beast-Repellent Torch
how: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.

name: Beastclaw Greathammer
how: Given by Gurranq after turning in their 7th Deathroot.

name: Beastman's Cleaver
how: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

name: Beastman's Curved Sword
how: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

name: Black Bow
how: Bow that can be found on the roof on the right that overlooks the area. Need to jump from roof to roof in order to reach it.

name: Black Knife
how: Dagger dropped from the Black Knife Assassin

name: Black Steel Greathammer
how: Greathammer dropped by the heavy armored guard of the Church of Consolation. This is a guaranteed drop when you first kill him.

name: Black Steel Twinblade
how: Drops from Black Knight at the top of the hill encampment. He is guarded by many Messmer Soldiers along the way.

name: Blade of Calling
how: From the Forbidden Lands site of grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Blade of Calling is on the table in the room at the end of this hall

name: Blasphemous Blade
how: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

name: Bloodfiend's Arm
how: Colossal Weapon. Guaranteed drop from the chief Bloodfiend at the top of Prospect Town. One time only.

name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
how: The Bloodfiend west of Taylew's Ruined Forge drops this when killed.

name: Bloodhound Claws
how: Claw. Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight in the secret passage of Volcano Manor .

name: Bloodhound's Fang
how: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol , Bloodhound Knight Darriwil .

name: Bloodstained Dagger
how: Dropped by Demihuman chief/Demihuman assassin sleeping before the wooden bridge leading to the minor eldtree in the weeping peninsula.

name: Bloody Helice
how: Can be found inside a chest, in the same room of the boss in Writheblood Ruins

name: Bolt of Gransax

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: On the giant spear in the Avenue plaza of the Royal Capital; gone in the Ashen Capital.

how: Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital after beating Godfrey, First Elden Lord; walk outside of the west door, take the elevator down, and walk up the spear.

name: Bone Bow
how: A Bone Bow can be found being protected by 2 giant Spider-Scorpions, inside the massive tower.

name: Bonny Butchering Knife
how: Below a small shed, outside a house. Near the broken bridge.

name: Brick Hammer
how: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.

name: Broadsword
how: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

name: Butchering Knife
how: Greataxe . Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater .

name: Caestus
how: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

name: Cane Sword
how: West Capital Ramparts Site of Grace, Go south out of the room with the site of grace and down the flight of stairs to the floor underneath, make a complete U-turn in the room with the stairs to find a corpse with the sword

name: Carian Glintblade Staff
how: Staff. Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .

name: Carian Glintstone Staff
how: Found at the Carian Study Hall.

name: Carian Knight's Sword
how: Straight Sword. Found in a chest at the back of a large stagecoach being pulled by 2 Trolls.

name: Carian Regal Scepter
how: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

name: Carian Sorcery Sword
how: In a chest after dropping down into Castle Ensis from Scadu Altus.

name: Celebrant's Cleaver
how: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake
how: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

name: Celebrant's Sickle
how: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

name: Celebrant's Skull
how: Warhammer. Found on a corpse at the cliff directly north from Windmill village site of grace

name: Chainlink Flail
how: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
how: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. In a small room at the lower floor area, the first room to the right after exiting the ladder room.

name: Cinquedea
how: Dagger. Found outside the bestial sanctum, after a long series of platforms starting on the west side to drop down onto the external structure's base.

name: Cipher Pata
how: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

name: Clawmark Seal
how: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

name: Claws of Night
how: Dropped by NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna, found in the ruins underneath Cathedral of Manus Metyr. This area can only be accessed by progressing Ymir's questline.

name: Clayman's Harpoon
how: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

name: Claymore
how: Greatsword. From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.

name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
how: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.

name: Cleanrot Spear
how: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

name: Clinging Bone
how: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

name: Club
how: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

name: Coded Sword
how: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Look for an abandoned horse stable, then climb onto its roof and enter the building. Keep going until you find a broken round table. Look for the double door. Inside that room you will find the coded sword.

name: Commander's Standard
how: Halberd. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

name: Composite Bow
how: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
how: Warhammer. Found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave on a corpse at the end of the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the room with the flamethrower pillar.

name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
how: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

name: Crescent Moon Axe
how: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

name: Cross-Naginata
how: Spear. Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel , in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.

name: Crystal Knife
how: Dagger. Found in a chest inside the storage room in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel protected by Marionettes.

name: Crystal Spear
how: Can be found inside Sellia Hideaway . It can be found in a chest to the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations. The hidden wall is on the left side of a corpse

name: Crystal Staff
how: Crystal Staff can be found in Academy Crystal Cave . It's in a room guarded by a sorcerer behind a fog wall, located right before the boss gate. The path to the chest containing the staff is through an illusory rock wall on the left side of the tunnel, just before the stone archway.

name: Crystal Sword
how: CStraight Sword. Can be found at Village of the Albinaurics . Past the well and the wooden bridge, on a body near the edge.

name: Curved Club
how: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

name: Curved Great Club
how: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

name: Dagger
how: Looted from a Foot Soldier upon defeat.

name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
how: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum

name: Dark Moon Greatsword
how: Greatsword . Found below the Cathedral of Manus Celes after progressing Ranni 's questline.

name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
how: Can be purchased from the Thiollier for 9000 Runes.

name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
how: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Scorpion River Catacombs .

name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
how: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .

name: Death Ritual Spear
how: Spear. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss upon defeat.

name: Death's Poker
how: Greatsword. Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.

name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
how: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

name: Devonia's Hammer
how: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .

name: Devourer's Scepter
how: Great Hammer. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

name: Digger's Staff
how: Drops from Diggers inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .

name: Dismounter
how: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

name: Dragon Communion Seal
how: Found in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Progress down the tunnel with the mechanized chariot until the path splits and you can go either up or down. Go up until you reach the end of the tunnel and inside the small room is an enemy that once killed will give you the weapon.

name: Dragon Greatclaw
how: Colossal Weapon that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel

name: Dragon Halberd
how: Halberd. Obtained when defeating the Dragonkin Soldier in Siofra River .

name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
how: Dropped by the Ancient Dragon-Man mini-boss located in the Dragon's Pit.

name: Dragon King's Cragblade
how: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

name: Dragonscale Blade
how: Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier

name: Dryleaf Seal
how: Sacred Seal looted from a platform under the message in the lower areas of this region.

name: Duelist Greataxe
how: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

name: Eclipse Shotel
how: Curved Sword. Found at the altar of the Church in the southeast section of the castle.

name: Eleonora's Poleblade
how: Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger

name: Envoy's Greathorn
how: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

name: Envoy's Horn
how: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

name: Envoy's Long Horn
how: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

name: Erdsteel Dagger
how: Dagger. Rewarded by Kenneth Haight for clearing out Fort Haight .

name: Erdtree Bow
how: Climb the root found at the east, head up to the west, once outside again, jump on the roof to the left and enter inside the window. Loot the chest.

name: Erdtree Greatbow
how: Dropped from the Chariot inside Fringefolk Hero's Grave

name: Erdtree Seal
how: Sacred Seal. Found on a corpse in a building close to the Omenkiller in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

name: Estoc
how: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

name: Euporia
how: Found after dropping down a secret area in Enir Ilim, after doing some difficult platforming

name: Executioner's Greataxe
how: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

name: Falchion
how: Dropped by Demi-Human enemies under the bridge.

name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
how: Colossal Weapon Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast

name: Falx
how: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.

name: Family Heads
how: Flail. Dropped from boss of Sage's Cave , Necromancer Garris.

name: Finger Seal
how: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

name: Fire Knight's Seal
how: Shadow Keep . In the area with the giant Queen Marika statue, it is behind the statue. You have to use the lever to lower the water level.

name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
how: Weapon. Found in a chest guarded by both Perfumers and Messmer Soldiers.

name: Flail
how: It can be found in a charriot, defended by a group of soldiers. near the Gatefront Ruins

name: Flamberge
how: Greatsword found on a corpse on the roof of the building in the southeast of Redmane Castle .

name: Flowerstone Gavel
how: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.

name: Flowing Curved Sword
how: Curved Sword. Found within the chest of the Enemy Caravan traveling the Consecrated Snowfield south-western area.

name: Forked Greatsword
how: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.

name: Forked Hatchet
how: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

name: Frenzied Flame Seal
how: Weapon. Reward from completing Hyetta's Questline. Hyetta can be finally found at Frenzied Flame Proscription, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Upon accepting the Three Fingers flame, return to Hyetta and talk to her once more. Exhaust her dialogue, and she will give you the Frenzied Flame Seal, completing her questline.

name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
how: The weapon is looted from a dead body located by the northern interior of the Abandoned Church.

name: Freyja's Greatsword
how: Can be looted from Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim .

name: Frozen Needle
how: Thrusting Sword. Found in a chest inside a small room in an underground area of the ruins. The Royal Revenant needs to be defeated to gain access to this room.

name: Full Moon Crossbow
how: Weapon. From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump o

name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
how: Greataxe. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
how: Twinblades. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
how: Halberd dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .

name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
how: Greatsword dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .

name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
how: Dropped by Gargoyle . From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree .Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.

name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
how: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle when both bosses are defeated

name: Gargoyle's Halberd
how: Dropped by the Lesser Black Blade Kindred.

name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
how: Dropped by Vailant Gargoyle (Twinblade) when both bosses are defeated

name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
how: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

name: Ghiza's Wheel
how: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor .

name: Ghostflame Torch
how: Ghostflame Torch can be found on a body at Nokron, Eternal City. To find it, you must start from the beginning of Nokron, Eternal City, entering from the Meteorite Crater. Once you get to the first set of rooves in Nokron, you will see a derelict tower off to the right of the roof ramp. You will need to jump from the ramp to the tower to reach torch. There is no other way to reach the Ghostflame T

name: Giant-Crusher
how: Colossal Weapon. Can be found in a chest inside an unmarked military camp directly to the south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

name: Giant's Red Braid
how: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

name: Giant's Seal
how: Sacred Seal found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave : In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate . Defeat it and check the right side of the room for a corpse holding the seal. Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small sp

name: Glaive
how: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

name: Glintstone Kris
how: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

name: Glintstone Staff
how: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

name: Godskin Peeler
how: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village .

name: Godskin Stitcher
how: Dropped by Godskin Noble

name: Godslayer's Greatsword
how: Greatsword found in a chest in a room behind the Godskin Apostle's arena at the Divine Tower of Caelid after defeating him.

name: Godslayer's Seal
how: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion 's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is fo

name: Golden Epitaph
how: Straight Sword . Found on a corpse in a room locked behind an Imp Statue Seal just past the Site of Grace. Use a Stonesword Key to unlock the seal and beware the Basilisk guarding the treasure.

name: Golden Halberd
how: Drops from Tree Sentinel

name: Golden Order Greatsword
how: Found inside Cave of the Forlorn . Dropped by Misbegotten Crusader

name: Golden Order Seal
how: Found right at the base of the Minor Erdtree surrounded by the remains of the Church.

name: Golem Greatbow
how: Chance to drop by Golem Archer.

name: Golem's Halberd
how: Dropped by one of the Golems at the bridge.

name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
how: Greatsword. Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.

name: Grafted Dragon
how: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

name: Grave Scythe
how: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

name: Gravel Stone Seal
how: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, walk north to the next room with the single guard inside. Jump over the balcony railing to get to the area next to the Fortified Manor with the dragon foot. The knight with the spear supported by an archer drops this seal.

name: Great Club
how: Hammer Weapon. Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.

name: Great Épée
how: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.

name: Great Katana
how: The Great Katana can be found next to the sleeping Ghostflame Dragon on the lake, west of the Abandoned Ailing Village site of grace.

name: Great Knife
how: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

name: Great Mace
how: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.

name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
how: Greataxe. Dropped by the boss duo of Perfumer's Grotto : Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom .

name: Great Stars
how: On a guarded wagon in Altus Plateau, traveling on the road SouthWest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path site of grace.

name: Greataxe
how: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.

name: Greatbow
how: Found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower .

name: Greathorn Hammer
how: Dropped by Ancestral Follower located in Siofra River

name: Greatsword
how: Colossal Sword. Looted from the chest in the enemy caravan traveling the Caelid Highway .

name: Greatsword of Solitude
how: This item is obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight . This boss is located inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

name: Grossmesser
how: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

name: Guardian's Swordspear
how: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

name: Halberd
how: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

name: Halo Scythe
how: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

name: Hammer
how: Found inside the Fortified manor, beside the Sanctified Whetblade

name: Hand Axe
how: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

name: Hand Ballista
how: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

name: Hand of Malenia
how: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

name: Harp Bow
how: Acquired by solving the Champion's Song Painting, found in The Shaded Castle

name: Heavy Crossbow
how: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

name: Helphen's Steeple
how: Greatsword. Dropped by the Tibia Mariner boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol .

name: Highland Axe
how: Axe. Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.

name: Hookclaws
how: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.

name: Horn Bow
how: Bow. Found on a corpse under the stairs leading to Hallowhorn Grounds .

name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
how: Guaranteed drop from the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim.

name: Horned Warrior's Sword
how: Curved Sword dropped by the Horned Warrior found in the norhwestern area of the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp.

name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
how: Whip. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

name: Icerind Hatchet
how: Axe found inside a chest in the Temple Quarter . The chest is located in what remains of the tower of a ruined building, by some poison flowers.

name: Igon's Greatbow
how: After defeating Bayle the Dread while Igon is summoned, Igon will drop this item at his last location at the Foot of the Jagged Peak Drake.

name: Inquisitor's Girandole
how: Spear . Dropped by the Abductor Virgins .

name: Inseparable Sword
how: Prince of Death's Throne, after giving D's brother D's Twinned Set

name: Iron Ball
how: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart .

name: Iron Cleaver
how: Dropped by one of the enemies that can be found at behind the big door, on the right side.

name: Iron Greatsword
how: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

name: Iron Spear
how: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

name: Ivory Sickle
how: Dagger. Can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics .It is up a small hill from the Site of Grace, past a perfumer enemy, behind a coffin. Nearby, Albus hides as a pot.

name: Jar Cannon
how: Ballista. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot when defeated.

name: Jawbone Axe
how: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

name: Katar
how: First Weapon. Looted from a treasure chest in Fort Gael . You can find the chest inside a dark room on the elevated platform above the Lion Guardian.

name: Knight's Greatsword
how: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

name: Lamenting Visage
how: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol , you'll need to obtain the Gaol Lower Level Key to gain access.

name: Lance
how: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs . Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.

name: Large Club
how: On the lowest cliff south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol , near a spiritspring

name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
how: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

name: Leda's Sword
how: Dropped by Needle Knight Leda upon defeat.

name: Light Crossbow
how: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
how: Located on a corpse in the middle of a big puddle of water guarded by a rolling lightning ram enemy.

name: Lion Greatbow
how: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

name: Longbow
how: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

name: Longhaft Axe
how: Rare drop from enemies wielding it at Castle Mourne in Weeping Peninsula. There is an easy to kill one from Beside the Rampant Gaol site of grace, cross the bridge and will be on the left sleeping.

name: Longsword
how: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.

name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
how: Greatsword. Found inside a Wagon Chest.

name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
how: Dropped by a head-less, undead Soldier at Fourth Church of Marika.

name: Loretta's War Sickle
how: Halberd. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree .

name: Lucerne
how: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.

name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
how: Glintstone Staff. Found in a chest in the building north of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses' chamber after defeating them.

name: Mace
how: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.

name: Madding Hand (weapon)
how: The weapon is acquired upon defeating the hostile NPC, Madding Hand.

name: Magma Blade
how: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

name: Magma Whip Candlestick
how: Whip . Rewarded by Patches after completing his Volcano Manor quest.

name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
how: Curved Greatsword dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar

name: Main-gauche
how: Midway through the Stairs, turn right and enter the room. Enter the room on the right, and defeat the enemies to find the body that contains this weapon on the other side.

name: Maliketh's Black Blade
how: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

name: Mantis Blade
how: Dropped by a Cemetary Shade inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . This enemy can be found by heading down the first Chariot hall until you reach a point where there is a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop into the left pit onto some wooden beams and then drop into the room below. The shade is in an alcove in the eastern wall.

name: Marais Executioner's Sword
how: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

name: Marika's Hammer
how: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

name: Maternal Staff
how: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers

name: Meteoric Ore Blade
how: Katana. Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins .

name: Meteorite Staff
how: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.

name: Milady
how: The Milady Light Greatsword weapon can be found inside a chest. The chest is located at the top of a watchtower.

name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
how: Straight Sword . Found atop a belltower. You can reach this belltower by entering the second alcove on the left of the eastern walkway, heading up the stairs and then jumping onto the tree branch on the balcony. Follow the tree branch up and across to reach the tower.

name: Misbegotten Shortbow
how: There are flying enemies at the top of the castle. Thet may drop this weapon when killed.

name: Miséricorde
how: Dagger. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
how: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

name: Monk's Flameblade
how: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

name: Monk's Flamemace
how: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
how: The weapon drops from defeating the hostile NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

name: Moonveil
how: Katana. Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel .

name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
how: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

name: Morning Star
how: Hammer-type Weapon. Found in a chest inside a broken wagon along the road.

name: Nagakiba
how: Can be obtained by completing Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline at the Second Church of Marika

name: Nanaya's Torch
how: From Midra's Library Site of Grace, you'll need to move one of the bookshelves by pulling a lever in the same room. The balcony you need to reach is directly above the inquisitor below. This torch is on a corpse sitting on a chair, wearing a yellow cloth that resembles that of Hyetta.

name: Nightrider Flail
how: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

name: Nightrider Glaive
how: Halberd dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry . Only appears at night.

name: Noble's Estoc
how: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.  Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

name: Noble's Slender Sword
how: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

name: Nox Flowing Hammer
how: From the Night Sacred Ground Site of Grace in Nokron, go up the stairs to your right. You should find yourself in a room with a Nox Monk and a Silver Tear Ball. Slay these enemies, then ascend a ladder to the back right of the room. Go down the path to the right of the Altar to where you see a Gargoyle Fog Wall. Turn right about halfway down the hallway and you should see a Roof Path out a window

name: Nox Flowing Sword
how: Curved Sword. Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses upon defeat.

name: Obsidian Lamina
how: Complete the entirety of Sir Ansbach's questline by assisting him. This weapon will be available at the end of his questline after the Final Boss where he will be by the entrance to the arena after the fight.

name: Omen Cleaver
how: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Omen enemy in the northwest section of the courtyard. It is advised to take out all of the lesser enemies nearby before taking on the ogre.

name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
how: Curved Greatsword . Dropped by the Onyx Lord when defeated.

name: Ordovis's Greatsword
how: Greatsword . Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and his regular Crucible Knight companion in their Duo Boss Fight inside the Auriza Hero's Grave .

name: Ornamental Straight Sword
how: Straight Sword. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

name: Parrying Dagger
how: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

name: Partisan
how: A Partisan Spear that can be dropped from a Godrick Knight in Fort Haight .

name: Pata
how: Fist Weapon looted from a corpse hanging on the cliff just north from the Church of Benediction . This same corpse has the Oathseeker Set

name: Pest's Glaive
how: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

name: Pickaxe
how: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

name: Pike
how: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace

name: Poisoned Hand
how: Across the previous Knot Resin, there is a Horned Warrior, in a big area. To that area's right, there is a medium-sized building, similar to a church, and beside it, you will find the Poisoned Hand weapon. Note that the building is infested with Man-Fly.

name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
how: Drops from the Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd

name: Prince of Death's Staff
how: Climbing on the roots to reach up the towers, it's in one of them.

name: Pulley Bow
how: Pulley Bow can be found on a sitting corpse (at the top of a siege tower near Mt. Gelmir campsite. The tower is located to the northeast of Gelmir Hero's Grave.

name: Pulley Crossbow
how: Can be found on a body at the Craftsman's Shack

name: Queelign's Greatsword
how: Use Iris of Occultation on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive Queelign's Greatsword .

name: Rabbath's Cannon
how: Rabbath's Rise. After you free the Spiritspring, head outside and use it while mounted on Torrent to reach the higher part of the tower. Loot the chest at the top to obtain this weapon.

name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
how: Dropped by Rakshasa at Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

name: Rapier
how: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

name: Raptor Talons
how: Located at Sage's Cave , in one of the chests, behind several secret walls

name: Red Bear's Claw
how: Weapon drops upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum .

name: Red Branch Shortbow
how: Drops from an Assassin on the study, past the Trumpeteer

name: Reduvia
how: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus

name: Regalia of Eochaid
how: Straight Sword. Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave

name: Repeating Crossbow
how: along the road next to the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South site of Grace

name: Ringed Finger
how: Hammer found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . From the first Chariot hallway, head all the way down and turn left at the end of the path to find a room with a chest containing the weapon.

name: Ripple Blade
how: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
how: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

name: Rivers of Blood
how: Katana dropped by NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina . Spawns near the Church of Repose in the later areas of the game.

name: Rogier's Rapier
how: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

name: Rosus' Axe
how: An Axe found in the room sealed by the Imp Statue in the Black Knife Catacombs.

name: Rotten Battle Hammer
how: Warhammer. Guaranteed drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area

name: Rotten Crystal Spear
how: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

name: Rotten Crystal Staff
how: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

name: Rotten Crystal Sword
how: Straight Sword . Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians . From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.

name: Rotten Greataxe
how: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by the duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town

name: Rotten Staff
how: Colossal Weapon . Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the ring walkway in the east.

name: Royal Greatsword
how: Obtainable at the end of Ranni's questline; Blaidd will spawn in front of Ranni's Rise tower. Best him in combat for a final time to obtain this weapon along with his armor set.

name: Ruins Greatsword

missable.note: The Misbegotten Warrior + Crucible Knight duo at Redmane Castle is replaced while the Festival is active; defeat them first (reaching Altus or progressing Ranni auto-triggers the Festival).

how: Acquired by defeating the Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo bosses at Redmane Castle

name: Rusted Anchor
how: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel .

name: Sacred Relic Sword
how: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

name: Sacrificial Axe
how: Axe. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)

name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
how: Found in Mt. Gelmir , on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge northwest of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace. The corpse closest to the ladder has the blade.

name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
how: Dropped together with the All-Knowing Set upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital .

name: Scimitar
how: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

name: Scorpion's Stinger
how: Dagger . Found in a chest to the very west of the Grand Cloister .

name: Scythe
