how: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.

name: Sentry's Torch
how: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

name: Serpent Bow
how: Found by a pool of rot within Abandoned Cave

name: Serpent Flail
how: Head down using the ladder past the first tower, and defeat the enemies. Beware of the flamethrowers. Use spells or arrows if you have them. Reach the end of the area to find a chest that contains this item

name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
how: Can be found at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, after the first singing bat go up two ladders then another one on the left and walk across to where the Land Octopus are

name: Serpent-Hunter
how: Great Spear . Held by a corpse on the left as you enter the boss chamber of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy . This weapon has a special interaction when fighting Rykard in both his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent and second phase as Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

name: Serpentbone Blade
how: Katana . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the second letter quest.

name: Shamshir
how: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.

name: Short Spear
how: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

name: Short Sword
how: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

name: Shortbow
how: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

name: Shotel
how: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.

name: Siluria's Tree
how: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria

name: Smithscript Axe
how: Location: Taylew's Ruined Forge . From the initial site of grace, continue following the path, get past the enemy, and take the ladder down then jump across the other platforms and turn left. You will find a Golem there. Behind it, at the back of the room, you will find the Smithscript Axe.

name: Smithscript Cirque
how: The weapon is looted from a body in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The body is located by the edge of the sewage waterfall.

name: Smithscript Dagger
how: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Take the first ladder down, past the golem, and after the fire blob turn right. As soon as you enter the room past the Fire Blob, slightly to the left. You can also drop down to this area from the lever's location. At the end of the hallway, you will find a golem and this weapon on a corpse near the back wall.

name: Smithscript Greathammer
how: Use the giant platform in the middle to jump to the other side. Once there, keep moving forward and on the left side there will be a fire blob enemy protecting the item. Defeat the enemy and loot the corpse behind it to obtain the weapon.

name: Smithscript Spear
how: The weapon is looted from a body located on the main floor of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

name: Soldier's Crossbow
how: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

name: Spear
how: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

name: Spiked Caestus
how: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.

name: Spiked Club
how: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

name: Spiked Spear
how: Chance for it to drop from a Marionette Soldier enemy just outside of Witchbane Ruins .

name: Spiraltree Seal
how: Reward for completing "The Sacred Tower" Painting Puzzle .

name: Spirit Glaive
how: Charro's Hidden Grave: This Halberd Can be found on a corpse surrounded by gravestones in the northeastern edges of the area.

name: Spirit Sword
how: Cerulean Coast: Located on a corpse lying next to some gravestones guarded by demi-humans. You can access this area by following the path East from Cerulean Coast West

name: Spread Crossbow
how: A Spread Crossbow can be found on a body by the riverside and the Ellac Greatbridge. Past the Ellac Greatbridge turn right and head to the lower level. There is a smaller camp with three Messmer Soldiers. There you will find the Spread Crossbow.

name: St. Trina's Torch
how: Special Torch. Looted from the treasure chest in the caravan wagon carted in the southern portion of Consecrated Ground in the northern lands.

name: Staff of Loss
how: Glintstone Staff. Found on a corpse leaning over a building's balcony. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

name: Staff of the Avatar
how: Drops from the Erdtree Avatar you encounter near the Great Waterfall Crest site of grace. To reach the area, you have to defeat the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss then lie down on the coffin at the back

name: Staff of the Guilty
how: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.

name: Star Fist
how: In the left side of a castle situated atop the mountain near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital .

name: Star-Lined Sword
how: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who can be found in Cerulean Coast's Demi-Human Valley.

name: Starscourge Greatsword
how: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

name: Steel-Wire Torch
how: Torch. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.

name: Stone Club
how: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
how: This is one of the three altars that affect the Stone-Sheathed Sword. The first one gives you the sword, then you may get the Sword of Darkness or the Sword of Light. Raise the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the light or darkness at this altar to unlock the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness

name: Stormhawk Axe
how: 2x Found under the bridge leading from the swamp up to Village of the Albinaurics if Nepheli Leux has died.

name: Swift Spear
how: The Swift Spear can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the road

name: Sword of Milos

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Dung Eater's moat invasion does not occur in the Ashen Capital.

how: Greatsword . Dropped by Dung Eater as an NPC invader upon defeat.

name: Sword of Night
how: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Iris of Occultation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes

name: Sword of Night and Flame
how: Straight Sword. Found in a chest inside a locked room behind the gardens. This is accessible by using the walkways above. You can get onto the walkways from the Chapel building in the west.

name: Sword of St. Trina
how: Found inside a chest in the underground cellar of the Forsaken Ruins .

name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
how: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight.-

name: Thorned Whip
how: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

name: Tooth Whip
how: Found inside the Whipping Hut.

name: Torch
how: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

name: Torchpole
how: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

name: Treespear
how: Found on the Caravan left at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

name: Troll Knight's Sword
how: Colossal Sword. Dropped by a Troll Knight guarding the staircase leading up to the boss of Caria Manor.

name: Troll's Golden Sword
how: In a Chest on a Black Carriage, which can be found east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace.

name: Troll's Hammer
how: Hammer Weapon. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

name: Twinblade
how: Underground. Can be found once you take the stairs down Dragon-Burnt Ruins .

name: Twinned Knight Swords
how: In a burning corpse pile in front of East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau .

name: Uchigatana
how: Found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. It is in a body, hanging from the upper platform. You need to use the lever in order to reach that room. Beware of the Skeleton Archers.

name: Urumi
how: Whip. Found on a body on the south-east ramparts, reached by jumping from the higher ramparts leading to the elevator and the Manor Upper Level site of grace.

name: Varré's Bouquet
how: Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading him and depleting his dialogue.

name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
how: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. The sword is in a small cave network there and guarded by several putrescent oozes.

name: Venomous Fang
how: Claw Weapons. Climb on the Iron Maidens near the end of the Abandoned Cave to acquire them.

name: Veteran's Prosthesis
how: Fist Weapon. Dropped by Commander Niall upon defeat.

name: Vulgar Militia Saw
how: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
how: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world

name: Vyke's War Spear
how: Can be dropped from Festering Fingerprint Vyke

name: Wakizashi
how: Dagger. Found within Gaol Cave

name: Warhawk's Talon
how: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

name: Warped Axe
how: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

name: Warpick
how: Looted from one of the many Undead Soldiers .

name: Watchdog's Greatsword
how: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

name: Watchdog's Staff
how: Located in Road's End Catacombs , behind an illusory wall near the stairs at the beginning of the dungeon.

name: Weathered Straight Sword
how: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

name: Whip
how: Whip. Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on t

name: Wing of Astel
how: Curved Sword . Found in a small chest at the top of the ruins in southern Uhl Palace Ruins . Inaccessible until entering from the Northern, higher level section.

name: Winged Greathorn
how: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship.  In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.

name: Winged Scythe
how: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins , there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.

name: Zamor Curved Sword
how: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.

name: Zweihander
how: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

name: Black Whetblade
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse slumped in front of an altar in Night's Sacred Ground .

name: Glintstone Whetblade
how: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on the fence of an office balcony. From the fountain of the academy's courtyard, go west and head up the slope. The office is in front of the group of kneeling Noble Zombies.

name: Iron Whetblade
how: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

name: Red-Hot Whetblade
how: Key Item. Found in Redmane Castle , at the bottom level of the gate house building east of the main gate.

name: Sanctified Whetblade

missable.lockedBy: Burning the Erdtree (Forge of the Giants)
missable.note: Royal Capital only; unlocks Holy/Lightning affinities. Collect before Farum Azula.

how: Found inside the fortified manor, you have to access by jumping through the roof and entering the building.
